End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	
	satirno=satirno+1
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 8)
If satirno = 21 then
'	res = pe1.box(45,6,160,136)
 	res=pe1.pagebreak
	k = 0
	satirno=1
	satirbaslangic=161 
End If	
	satirpozr= satirbaslangic + (satirno - 1) * 5
' FOKOD		
' FOKOD
' FOKOD
	KTIP=Trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i))
If KTIP = "H" Then	
	STKOD=MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,9,4,58,STKOD)
	MIK=Doc.NumFormat0(MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i),25,3)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,115,4,25,MIK)
	STKAD=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",STKOD,-1) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,68,4,50,STKAD)
	MIKBRM=MMPS10T.KAYNAK_BIRIM(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,140,4,10,MIKBRM)
		ELSE 
	
	STKOD=MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,158,4,30,STKOD)
	MIK=Doc.NumFormat(MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i),25,3)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,115,4,25,MIK)
	MIKBRM=MMPS10T.KAYNAK_BIRIM(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,140,4,10,MIKBRM)
'	res=pe1.pensize(0.2)
'	res = pe1.line(satirpozr+5,6,0,136)
'	res=pe1.pensize(0.5)
 End If


 res = pe1.Setbold(0)
 res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)
 res = pe1.Write(282,160,4,50,"Q Form TKM-04-06.9")

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	satirno=1
	satirbaslangic=56 
	satirpozr=0
  SYuk = 4.3*2
	Satirsayisi = 0
	j = 1
	k = 0
	yan = 8
	ust= 3
	SS = 0
	SKd = " "
	
	bb=4*4.3
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
  res = pe1.Open(0,"Toplu MPS Emri",297,210,"LANDSCAPE")
'	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
'	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(33)
'	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(10)

 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
 Satirsayisi = MMPS30T.GetRecCount()	 

	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		SEC = MMPS30T.SELECTED(i)
	If SEC = "E" Then    
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
		satirno=satirno+1
	End If
	Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)

'	MPSNo = MMPS30T.EVRAKNO(i)
	
'				res = pe1.PageBreak()
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

	If satirno = 25 Then
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	res=pe1.pagebreak
	satirno=1
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirbaslangic=56 
End If
	
	satirpozr= ust+satirbaslangic + (satirno - 1) * 5

	HINO = MMPS30T.EVRAKNO(i)

	TMM = Doc.NumFormat_NLZ((MMPS30T.SF_BAKIYEMIKTAR(i)),25,3)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+112,5,20,TMM)
'	MUST = MMPS30T. MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_AD(i)
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+136,5,27,MUST)

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, SatirBitis
Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, ToplamProTutar, old, baslangic, s, y, toplamyuzde, toplammiktar, yuzdesol, t
Public xCizgi(), miktarsol	, miktargen, yuzdegen
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 20
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = 80
	satirsonu=altmargin-70
	Baslangic=ustmargin+10
	toplamyuzde=0
	toplammiktar=0
	yuzdesol=0
	miktarsol=0
	miktargen=0
	yuzdegen=0
	toplamtutar=0
	s=0
	y=0
	t=0	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Teklif",  SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = TEKL40T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To satirsayisi
			if trim(TEKL40T.KOD(i) )<>"" then
			t=t+1
			end if
	Next
		

	For i = 1 To t
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1, i)
	Next
						call sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1, sno)

	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)
	
	ReDim Preserve xCizgi(0)
		sol=solmargin
	res=pe1.setalign("center")
	res=pe1.setbold(1)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 200, "FORMÜL REÇETE BASKISI")
	res=pe1.setbold(0)

	res=pe1.setalign("left")
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-10, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 100, "Ýþlem Tarihi"&" "&":"&" "&doc.strtonordate(TEKL40E.TARIH))

		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 11, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 2
				ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
		Next
		res=pe1.write(satirbaslangic-16, solmargin-2, satiryuksekligi, 200, string(180,"-")	)
		res=pe1.write(satirbaslangic-6, solmargin-2, satiryuksekligi, 200, string(180,"-")	)	
	
		mamulkod=TEKL40T.KOD(sno)
		mamulad=doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", mamulkod, "")

' ********* ürün aðacýndaki açýklamayý, kta larý okur
		rows1 = Doc.SelectEQ("BOMU01E", "MAMULCODE", mamulkod) 
		Set Old1 = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_BOMU01E_SELECT")
		For z=1 to rows1 
			aktif = Old1.AKTIF_PASIF(z)
			If aktif="*" then
				
				revno=Old1.ACIKLAMA(z)
				evrakno=Old1.EVRAKNO(z)
				sertlik1=doc.GetUDFValue("B1",evrakno,"SRT2",0)
				sertlik2=doc.GetUDFValue("B1",evrakno,"SRT1",0)
				kopma1=doc.GetUDFValue("B1",evrakno,"KPM1",0)
				kopma2=doc.GetUDFValue("B1",evrakno,"KPM2",0)
				ozgula=doc.GetUDFValue("B1",evrakno,"OZG",0)
				yirtilma=doc.GetUDFValue("B1",evrakno,"YRT",0)
				metaleyapis=doc.GetUDFValue("B1",evrakno,"MTY",0)
				asinma=doc.GetUDFValue("B1",evrakno,"ASN",0)
			End if
		Next 
'**********	

		res=pe1.write(baslangic, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50, "FORMÜL :")
		res=pe1.write(baslangic, solmargin+24, satiryuksekligi, 130, trim(mamulkod)&" "&"/"&" "&trim(mamulad))
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 30, "Revizyon No :")
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi, solmargin+24, satiryuksekligi, 70, revno)
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 30, "Sertlik [IRHD]")
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin+27, satiryuksekligi, 30, ":"&"  "&doc.numformat(sertlik1, 10, 2))
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 30, "Sertlik [SHRA]")
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin+27, satiryuksekligi, 30, ":"&"  "&doc.numformat(sertlik2, 10, 2))
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin+55, satiryuksekligi, 30, "Kopma [MPA]")
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin+81, satiryuksekligi, 30, ":"&"  "&doc.numformat(kopma1, 10, 2))
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin+55, satiryuksekligi, 30, "Kopma [Uzama]")
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin+81, satiryuksekligi, 30, ":"&"  "&doc.numformat(kopma2, 10, 2))
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin+102, satiryuksekligi, 30, "Öz.Að")
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin+120, satiryuksekligi, 30, ":"&"  "&doc.numformat(ozgula, 10, 2))
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin+102, satiryuksekligi, 30, "Yýrtýlma")
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin+120, satiryuksekligi, 30, ":"&"  "&doc.numformat(yirtilma, 10, 2))
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin+142, satiryuksekligi, 30, "Metale yapýþma")
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin+171, satiryuksekligi, 30, ":"&"  "&doc.numformat(metaleyapis, 10, 2))
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin+142, satiryuksekligi, 30, "Aþýnma")
		res=pe1.write(baslangic+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin+171, satiryuksekligi, 30, ":"&"  "&doc.numformat(asinma, 10, 2))

		rows = Doc.SelectEQ("BOMU01T", "BOMREC_CODE", mamulkod) 
		Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_BOMU01T_SELECT")
		For k=1 to rows 
			aktif = Old.AKTIF_PASIF(k)
			Tip = Old.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(k)
			If aktif="*" and tip="H" then
				Call Print_form_satir(pe1, k, sno)
			End if
		Next 
		
				
		if sno <> t and t>1 then

			call sayfasonu(pe1)
			res=pe1.pagebreak()
			
			s=0
			y=0
			toplammiktar=0
			toplamyuzde=0
			toplamtutar=0
		end if

End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo, sno)
	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)
	
Dim satirpozr
		sol=solmargin
		If trim(TEKL40T.KOD(sno)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then

			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			s=1
			Call Arasayfa(pe1, sno)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			s=s+1
			y=y+1
			If s = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi

			End If
		End If		
					
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Select case degiskenadi
							case "?SNO"
								degisken=y
							case "?AD"
								degisken=doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", old.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(satirno), "")
							case "?FIYAT"
								degisken=Doc.StandartMaliyet_K("H",old.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(satirno),1,"","",TEKL40E.STDMALTYPE(1),"","ECU")
							case else
								Degisken = trim(cstr(old.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				End Select
				if degiskenadi="BOMREC_LOWERLIMIT" then
						yuzdesol=sol
						yuzdegen=sutungenisligi-4
						toplamyuzde=toplamyuzde+degisken
				elseif degiskenadi="BOMREC_KAYNAK0" then
						miktarsol=sol
						miktargen=sutungenisligi-4	
						toplammiktar=toplammiktar+degisken
				elseif degiskenadi="?FIYAT" then
						toplamtutar=toplamtutar+(old.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(satirno) * degisken)

				end if
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					if degiskenadi="?FIYAT" then
						degisken=doc.numformat(degisken, grid(i,1), 2)
					else
						degisken=doc.numformat(degisken, grid(i,1), 3)
					end if
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				Next
				
End Sub
Sub Sayfasonu(pe1)
		son=satirsonu+5
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		ortfiyat=doc.div(toplamtutar, toplammiktar)
			
		res=pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi, yuzdesol, satiryuksekligi, yuzdegen, doc.numformat(toplamyuzde, 12,3))	
		res=pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi, miktarsol, satiryuksekligi, miktargen, doc.numformat(toplammiktar, 12,3))	
		res=pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin+50, satiryuksekligi, yuzdegen, doc.numformat(toplamtutar, 12,2))	
		res=pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin+50, satiryuksekligi, yuzdegen, doc.numformat(ortfiyat, 12,2))	

					res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res=pe1.write(son, solmargin-2, satiryuksekligi, 200, string(180,"-")	)
		res=pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin-2, satiryuksekligi, 200, string(180,"-")	)
		res=pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 30, "TOPLAM    :"	)	
		res=pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50, "Toplam Tutar [EUR]    :"	)	
		res=pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50, "Birim Fiyat  :"	)	
		res=pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*5, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 150, "Not: Deðerlendirme En Yüksek Birim Fiyatlar Üstündendir"	)	

				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(6,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "?SNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE"
	Grid(2,0) = "?AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "BOMREC_LOWERLIMIT"
	Grid(4,0) = "BOMREC_KAYNAK0"
	Grid(5,0) = "?FIYAT"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 12
	Grid(1,1) = 45
	Grid(2,1) = 60
	Grid(3,1) = 20
	Grid(4,1) = 20
	Grid(5,1) = 25
	
	Grid(0,2) = "S.No"
	Grid(1,2) = "Kod"
	Grid(2,2) = "Hammadde"
	Grid(3,2) = "Yüzde"
	Grid(4,2) = "B2 Miktar"
	Grid(5,2) = "B.Fiyat[EUR]"
	
		
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	
		
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = TEKL40T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
res=pe1.selectfont("arial",10)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
 	satirYuksekligi = 20
	satirYuksekligi1 = 10
   sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	satirSonu= 180
	ilk=ustmargin+90	


   If satirpozr >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)	
       siraNo = 1
       res = pe1.PageBreak()
       Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
       satirpozr = satirbaslangic-5
			satirpozr1 = satirbaslangic-5
			ilk=ustmargin+90	
   Else
       If satirNo = 1 Then
           satirpozr = satirbaslangic-5
				satirpozr1 = satirbaslangic-5
				
       Else
            satirpozr = satirpozr + 15
		       satirpozr1 = satirpozr1 + 15
					
       End If
       siraNo = siraNo + 1
   End If

	
	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",10)
	
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	stokadi=STOK40T.KOD_STOK00_AD(satirNo)
	stokkodu=STOK40T.KOD(satirNo)
	testarih=Doc.StrtoNorDate(STOK40T.REV_RTESTARIH(satirNo))
	miktar=STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo)
	fiyat=STOK40T.OR_FIYAT(satirNo)
	
	
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr,solmargin,10,100,stokadi)	
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr,solmargin+140,10,30,testarih)
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr,solmargin+92,10,50,miktar)
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr,solmargin+112,10,50,fiyat)
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr1+5,solmargin,10,50,stokkodu)

	
End Sub

   Else

       End If
       siraNo = siraNo + 1
   End If
	



	
	res = pe1.setbold(0)

Sub PrintForm()
     Dim tableE, tableT
	ReDim AlanSayisi(100)		 
	ReDim xCizgi(100)
	ReDim Secilenler(100,3)
'	Set xCizgi = Nothing
	ToplamEn = 0
	BasilabilirAlan = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0

      sayfaTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "A - A4, L - Letter (Sürekli Form)", "Dinamo", "A")

      Select Case UCase(sayfaTuru)
              Case "L"
                      sayfaBoyu = 279.4
                      sayfaEni = 215.9
              Case "A"
                      sayfaBoyu = 297
                      sayfaEni = 210
              Case Else
                      K = MsgBox("A veya L giriniz", 48, "Uyarý")
      End Select					
        Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()

        	Set tableE = doc.GetTableObject("BOMU01E")
        	Set tableT = doc.GetTableObject("BOMU01T")
		Call Alanlar(TableE,TableT)
		If ToplamEn > 1.1 * SayfaEni Then
			k = SayfaBoyu
			l = SayfaEni
			SayfaEni = k
			SayfaBoyu = l
			Tip = "LANDSCAPE"
			res = pe1.Open(0, "Ürün Aðacý Listesi", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Tip)
		Else
			Tip = ""
			res = pe1.Open(0, "Ürün Aðacý Listesi", SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni , Tip)
		End If		

		BasilabilirAlan = SayfaEni - 20
		satirSonu = sayfaBoyu - 20

 		satirBaslangic = 70

		If doc.ErrorNumber Then
          	MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
			Exit Sub
        	End If
	Dim pe1
        siraNo = 0        
        Dim satirSayisi_tableT
        satirSayisi_tableT = tableT.GetRecCount()
        Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1, tableE)
        For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
					KTP = Trim(tableT.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(I))					
					If KTP = "H" Then
                Call Print_form_satir(pe1, tableT, I, tableE)
					End If
        Next
        
        Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, tableE)
	   res = pe1.ReadDoc("c:\deneme.vpe")

        res = pe1.Show()
        res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(ByVal pe1, ByVal tableT, ByVal satirNo, ByVal tableE)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
        satiryuksekligi = 6
        sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
        If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
                Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, tableE)
                siraNo = 1
                res = pe1.PageBreak()
                Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1, tableE)
                satirpozr = satirBaslangic
        Else
                If satirNo = 1 Then
                        satirpozr = satirBaslangic
                Else
                        satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
                End If
                siraNo = siraNo + 1
        End If
        
        res = pe1.StoreSet(1001)
		FontBoyu = FontAyarla(BasilabilirAlan,ToplamEn,10)
		res = pe1.selectfont("courier new", FontBoyu)
        res = pe1.setbold(0)
        Sol = 12
        res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  / 3.22 * BasilabilirAlan / ToplamEn
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
'				If DegiskenAdi = "" Then Exit For
				Degisken = trim(cstr(TableT.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Degisken = "BOMREC_YMAMULPS" Or Degisken = "BOMREC_YMAMULPM" Then
			 Grid(i,2) = " "
				End If
				If Isnumeric(Degisken) Then
'						msgbox degisken
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = DecimalHesapla(TableT,DegiskenAdi)
					Degisken = doc.numformat0(Degisken, 18, 3)
				Elseif IsDate(Degisken) Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				If SutunGenisligi > 0 Then
					res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
					xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
					j = j + 1
				End If	
			Next					 
        sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

End Sub

'dikey çizgiler

		  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))

		Next
'        Call imza(pe1)

End Sub

Sub Alanlar(TableE,TableT)

	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","BOMU01T")
	ReDim Preserve Grid(UBound(Grid,1),UBound(Grid,2)+1)

	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		Select Case trim(Grid(i,0))
			Case "BOMREC_SIRANO"
				Grid(i,2) = "Sýra No"
			Case "BOMREC_FO_OPTION" 
				Grid(i,2) = "FO/C"
			Case "BOMREC_INPUTTYPE" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Kaynak Tipi"
			Case "BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Kaynak Kodu"
			Case "KAYNAK_AD" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Kaynak Adý"
			Case "BOMREC_OPERASYON" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Operasyon"
			Case "OPERASTON_AD" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Operasyon Adý"
			Case "BOMREC_KAYNAK0" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Hammadde Miktarý veya Tezgah Süresi"
			Case "KAYNAK_BIRIM" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Birim"
			Case "BOMREC_PLANOPS" 
				Grid(i,2) = "PL ML OPT"
			Case "BOMREC_YMAMULPS" 
				Grid(i,2) = "PK NO"
			Case "BOMREC_YMAMULCODE" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Operasyon Sonu Üretilen Y.Mamul"
			Case "BOMREC_YMAMULPM" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Yarý Mamul Miktarý"
			Case "YMAMUL_BIRIM" 
				Grid(i,2) = "YM Birimi"
			Case "BOMREC_REPLACE_K_OPS" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Ana Hammadde Varyant Tanýmý"
			Case "BOMREC_REPLACE_C_OPS" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Ölçü Varyantý Tanýmý"
			Case "BOMREC_KAYNAK1" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Ayar Setup süresi"
			Case "BOMREC_KAYNAK2" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Yükleme Süresi"
			Case "KAYNAK_BIRIM" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Birim"
			Case "BOMREC_LOWERLIMIT" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Mamul Alt Limit"
			Case "BOMREC_UPPERLIMIT" 
				Grid(i,2) = "Mamul Üst Limit"
			Case "BOMREC_BATCH_UNIT" 
				Grid(i,2) = "BAT"
			Case "BOMREC_FLOORFLAG" 
				Grid(i,2) = "RND"
		End Select
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
	ToplamEn = ToplamEn / 3.22
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
        res = pe1.setbold(0)
        res = pe1.setitalic(0)
        res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
        res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
        res = pe1.setrotation(0)
        res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
        res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
        res = pe1.selectfont("courier new", 10)
        res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function BosMu(Table,Field)
	k=0
  	satir = Table.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To Satir
		AlanDegeri = trim(Table.GetFieldValue(Field,i))
		If Isnumeric(AlanDegeri) Then
			If  Alandegeri <> 0  Then
				k = k + 1
			End If
		Else
			If  AlanDegeri <> "" Then
				k = k + 1
			End If
		End If
	Next
	BosMu = k
End Function
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
    If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
        Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
    End If
    Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
    If Nokta = 0 Then
        ondalik = ""
    Else
        ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
    End If
    TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
    If SondaSifir > 0 Then
        ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
    ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
        ondalik = ondalik
    Else
        ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
    End If
    If Ayirac = 1 Then
        TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
    End If
    If ondalik = "" Then
        SayiBicimle = TamSayi
    Else
        SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
    End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
    Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
    If OndalikHane - Len(Sayi) > 0 Then
        SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
    Else
        SifirEkle = Sayi
    End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
    Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
    While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
        Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
    Wend
    SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
    If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
    Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
    k = Len(Sayi)
    For i = 0 To k - 1
        If i > 0 And i Mod 3 = 0 Then
            Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
        End If
        Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
    Next
    VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
    Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
    If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
    Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
    End If
End Function
Function DecimalHesapla(Table,Degisken)
k = 0
DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To Table.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(Table.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
DecimalHesapla = k
End Function

Public ustmargin, solmargin, satirbaslangic, satiryukseklik, satirpozr, sirano
Dim satirsayisi, i, satirsolmargin, sonsatir, altmargin, S70T
Sub PrintForm()
		
	Set pe1=Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(2)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	res = pe1.Open(0,"Fatura",281,216,"")
	ustmargin=43
	solmargin=10
	altmargin=170
	satirsolmargin=10
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set S70T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set S70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	S70T.CopyTable(S70)
	S70T.GROUPBY("KOD")
	

	satirSayisi = S70T.GetRecCount()
	satirbaslangic=103.2
	satiryukseklik=4.3
	sirano=1		
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		Call satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, -1)
	chadi2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, -1)

	chadres1=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, -1)
	chadres2=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, -1)
	chadres3=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, -1)
	chvergidairesi=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, -1)
	chvergino=Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, -1)
	res=pe1.Setbold(0)

	evrakno=	STOK70E.EVRAKNO(1)
	faturatarihi= Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.TARIH(1))
	res=pe1.Setbold(1)

	satirPoz = ustmargin
	satirAra = 4.3
	res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin, 5, 65, chadi)
	If trim(CHAdi) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirPoz, solmargin, 5, 65, chadi2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres1) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin, 5, 65, chadres1)
	End If
	If trim(chadres2) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin, 5, 65, chadres2)
	End If
	If trim(chadres3) <> "" Then
		satirpoz = satirPoz + satirAra
		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin, 5, 65, chadres3)
	End If
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+32, solmargin+33, 5,60, trim(chvergidairesi) & " / " &  trim(chvergino))
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+118, 5, 80, evrakno)
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryukseklik*5, solmargin+155, 5, 80, faturatarihi)
	IRSNO= S70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	IRSTAR=Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK60E", "TARIH", IRSNO, ""))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryukseklik*7, solmargin+155, 5, 80, irsno)

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryukseklik*8, solmargin+125, 5, 80, "ÝRSALÝYE TARÝHÝ :" & " " & IRSTAR)

	res=pe1.Setbold(0)

'	For i = 1 To S70T.GetRecCount()

'		If trim(irsaliyeNo) <> "" Then
'			If i>5 Then

'				res= pe1.write(ustmargin+13+ (i- 6)*4, solmargin+144, 5, 30, trim(irsaliyeno) & "-" & Doc.StrToNorDate(irsaliyetarihi))
'			Else
'				irsaliyetarihi=doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK60E", "TARIH", irsaliyeno, "")
'				res= pe1.write(ustmargin+13+ (i-1)*4, solmargin+113, 5, 30, trim(irsaliyeno) & "-" & Doc.StrToNorDate(irsaliyetarihi))
'			End If

'	Next
End Sub

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)

	If sirano > 18 Then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano=0
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If
	sirano=sirano+1
	satirpozr=satirbaslangic + (sirano-1) * satiryukseklik
	
	stokkodu=S70T.KOD(i)
	stokadi=Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, "")
	miktar=doc.numformat_nlz(S70T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 20, 2)
	fiyat=doc.div(S70T.TL_TUTAR(i), S70T.SF_MIKTAR(i))
	fiyat=doc.numformat(fiyat, 25,3)
	birim=S70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	tutar=doc.numformat(S70T.TL_TUTAR(i), 30, 2 )
	sipno=S70T.SIPNO(i)
	chsipno=Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO",sipno,  "")
	aciklama=S70T.NOTES(i)
	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-28, satiryukseklik, 19, chsipno) 
'	If Left(trim(aciklama), 1)="-" Then
'		aciklama1=mid(aciklama, 2, 1)
'		stokkodu1=S70T.KOD(aciklama1)
'		stokadi1=trim(Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu1, ""))
'		If len(trim(StokAdi1)) > 30 Then
'			StokAdi1 = left(StokAdi1,30)
'		End If
'		res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-6, satiryukseklik, 74, trim(stokadi) & " (" & trim(stokadi1) & ")") 
'		res= pe1.write(satirpozr+6, satirsolmargin-10, satiryukseklik, 100, "(" & stokadi1 &")") 
'	Else
'		res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-6, satiryukseklik, 74, stokadi) 
'	End If
	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin , satiryukseklik, 33,stokkodu ) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin + 35, satiryukseklik, 50,stokadi) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin + 85, satiryukseklik, 15, miktar)
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin + 100, satiryukseklik, 15, birim)
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin + 115, satiryukseklik, 27, fiyat) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin + 145, satiryukseklik, 35, tutar) 
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	
End Sub

Sub sayfasonu(pe1)	
	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)

	valor = STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1)
	If valor = STOK70E.TARIH(1) Then
		vadetarihi = "PESIN"
	Else
		vadetarihi=Doc.StrToNorDate(Valor)
	End If
	Toplam=doc.numformat(STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1), 30, 2)
	Nettoplam=STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	kdvtoplam=STOK70E.TL_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	geneltoplam=nettoplam + kdvtoplam
	Nettoplam=doc.numformat(Nettoplam, 30, 2)
	geneltoplam=doc.numformat(geneltoplam,30,2)
	kdvtevkifat=STOK70E.TL_KESINTI1(1)
	kdvtevkifat1 = kdvtevkifat
	odenecekmiktar=STOK70E.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	odenecekkdv=kdvtoplam - kdvtevkifat
	odenecekkdv=doc.numformat(odenecekkdv,30,2)
	kdvtoplam=doc.numformat(kdvtoplam, 30, 2)
	kdvtevkifat=doc.numformat(kdvtevkifat, 30, 2)	
	odenecekmiktar1 = odenecekmiktar
	odenecekmiktar=doc.numformat(odenecekmiktar, 30, 2)	
'	kdvorani=S70T.KDV_ORANI(1)
	kdvorani=18
	odemekosullari1=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	odemekosullari2=STOK70E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	faturatip=STOK70E.NITELIK(1)
	TLIskonto = STOK70E.TL_ISKONTOLARTOPLAMI(1)
	TLIskontoOrani = (TLIskonto / STOK70E.TL_NEWTOPLAM(1))*100
	Not1=STOK70E.S60_NOTES_1(1)
	Not2=STOK70E.S60_NOTES_2(1)
	Not3=STOK70E.S60_NOTES_3(1)

	Sol = satirsolmargin +100
	TutarSol = satirsolmargin + 145
	satirPozr = satirpozr+satiryukseklik
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol+7, satiryukseklik, 30, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 35, "MAL BEDELÝ") 
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res= pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 35, Toplam) 
	If TLIskonto  > 0 Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 35, "ISKONTO % " & doc.numformat(TLIskontoOrani,6,2)) 
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 35, doc.numformat(TLIskonto,20,2)) 		
	End If
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")

	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol+7, satiryukseklik, 35, "==================")	
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 35, "ARA TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 35, nettoplam)
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 35, "K.D.V.")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, satirsolmargin + 110, satiryukseklik, 35, "%" & doc.numformat(kdvorani,12,0))
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 35, kdvtoplam)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, TutarSol+7, satiryukseklik, 35, "==================")
	satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
	res = pe1.write(satirPozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 35, "GENEL TOPLAM")
	res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 35, geneltoplam)
	
	

	If kdvtevkifat <> "" Then
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr , Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "KDV TEVKÝFATI 9/10")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 35, kdvtevkifat)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol+7, satiryukseklik, 35, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK MÝKTAR")
		res = pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 35, odenecekmiktar)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol+7, satiryukseklik, 35, "-------------------------------")
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryukseklik, 50, "ÖDENECEK K.D.V. 1/10")
	res= pe1.Setalign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol, satiryukseklik, 35, odenecekkdv)
		satirPozr = satirPozr + satirYukseklik
		res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, TutarSol+7, satiryukseklik, 35, "-------------------------------")
	End If
	
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	dip=satirpozr+satiryukseklik*5
	yodenecekmiktar=Doc.numtotext(odenecekmiktar1)
	res= pe1.write(dip , satirsolmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not1)
	res= pe1.write(dip +satiryukseklik, satirsolmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not2)
	res= pe1.write(dip + satiryukseklik*2, satirsolmargin , satiryukseklik, 130, Not3)

	valtar = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK70E.VALORTARIH(1))
	vadeo=STOK70E.VALORORANI
	res= pe1.write(dip + satiryukseklik*3, satirsolmargin, satiryukseklik, 70,"VALÖR TARÝHÝ :  "&valtar)
	res= pe1.write(dip + satiryukseklik*4, satirsolmargin, satiryukseklik, 30, "VALÖR ORANI :  "&vaDEO)

	res=pe1.write(dip+satiryukseklik*5, satirsolmargin, satiryuksekliK, 150, "VADE AÞIMIMDA YUKARIDAKÝ VADE FARKI ORANI + KDV UYGULANIR.")
	kur=STOK70T.KUR(1)
	pb=S70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	dvztut = Doc.numformat(STOK70E.CH_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1),15,2)
	chk = STOK70E.CH_KUR(1)
	if trim(pb)<>"YTL" then
			
			res=pe1.write(dip+satiryukseklik*6, satirsolmargin, satiryukseklik, 70, pb&" "&"="&doc.numformat_NLZ(kur, 12, 4)&" "&doc.defaultpb)
			res=pe1.write(dip+satiryukseklik*7, satirsolmargin, satiryukseklik, 70, "DÖVÝZ TUTARI :  "&dvztut&" "&chk)
		end if 

		call yazi(yodenecekmiktar)
	res= pe1.write(dip + -satiryukseklik*2 , satirsolmargin , satiryukseklik, 150, yodenecekmiktar)


End Sub
Function yazi(yodenecekmiktar)
	if instr(1, yodenecekmiktar, "%")=0 then
	yodenecekmiktar=yodenecekmiktar&" "&doc.defaultpb
	Else
	yodenecekmiktar=replace(yodenecekmiktar, "%"," "&"YTL"&" ",1)&" "&"Ykr"
	END if
end function

Sub PrintForm()   
Dim pe1
	OperasyonSatirNo = 0
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"MPS Listeleri",297,210,"")

	KODU = ""
	STKOD = ""
	HAMURK = ""
	KALIPK = ""
	HMIK = 0
	HMIKBRM = ""
	HAMURK1 = ""
	HMIK1 = 0
	HMIKBRM1 = ""
	OPKODU = ""
	OPTMIK = 0
	PSURE = ""
	HSURE = ""
	TSURE = ""
	KLKODU = ""
'	KALIPSY = ""
'	GOZSY = ""

	j=0
	jj=0
	t=0
	tt=0
	k=0
	satirbaslangic=45
	satirno=0
	satirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)

	MamulKodu = MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("BOMU01E","MAMULCODE",MamulKodu)
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_BOMU01E_SELECT")

  For i = 1 to rows 
	  aktif = Old.AKTIF_PASIF(i)
  		if aktif="*" then
			MamulMiktar = Trim(Old.MAMULMIKTAR(i))
		End if
	Next
	RECETE1 = MamulMiktar

	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next	
	
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	SayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub


Sub SatirYazdir(pe1, i)
	rBaslangic = 22
	satirYuksekligi = 7
	solmargin=13
	
	KTIP = Trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i))
	KODU = Trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i))
	OPKODU = Trim(MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(i))
	KK = Mid(KODU,1,1) 

	If KTIP = "H" and Mid(KODU,1,2)= "KL"  Then
		KLKODU = KODU
		KALIPSY = Mid(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i),13,1)
		GOZSY = Mid(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i),16,1)
	End if

'***
If KTIP = "H" Then	
' ************************************************************************************
		STKOD = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
		STKGKD1 = Trim(doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","GK_1",STKOD,-1)) 
		STGKD =Mid(STKGKD1,1,1)
		Select Case TRIM(STGKD)
   		Case "G" 
		 		HAMURK = STKOD 
	    		HMIK=MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)   
		  		HMIKBRM=MMPS10T.KAYNAK_BIRIM(i)	
			Case Else
	  			ST = STKOD
 			End Select	

		IF LEFT(MMPS10TH.R_KAYNAKKODU(i), 1) = "H" THEN
			 HAMURK = STKOD 
		END IF

		res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+70,solmargin+47,10,30,HAMURK)

	 	If Trim(STKOD) >= "150_03_14_001" and Trim(STKOD) <= "150_03_15_9999"  Then	
			ETKKODU = STKOD
			ETKADI=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",ETKKODU,-1) 
			j=j+1
			jj = 179+j*4
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+jj,solmargin+88,satirYuksekligi,43,ETKKODU)
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+jj,solmargin+120,satirYuksekligi,60,ETKADI)
		Elseif Trim(STKOD) >= "150_02_09_001" and Trim(STKOD) <= "150_02_09_99999"  Then	
			METPTFEKODU = STKOD
			METPTFEADI=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",METPTFEKODU,-1) 
			METPTFEMIK=Doc.NumFormat(MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i),15,0)  
			t=t+1
			tt = 202.5+t*4
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+tt,solmargin+88,satirYuksekligi,40,METPTFEKODU)
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+tt,solmargin+118.3,satirYuksekligi,60,METPTFEADI)
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+tt,solmargin+162,satirYuksekligi,15,METPTFEMIK)
	 	Elseif Trim(STKOD) >= "150_26_01_001001"  and Trim(STKOD) <= "150_45_09_999999"  Then	
			METPTFEKODU = STKOD
			METPTFEADI=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",METPTFEKODU,-1) 
			METPTFEMIK=Doc.NumFormat(MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i),15,0)   
			t=t+1
			tt = 202.5+t*4
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+tt,solmargin+88,satirYuksekligi,40,METPTFEKODU)
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+tt,solmargin+118.3,satirYuksekligi,60,METPTFEADI)
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+tt,solmargin+162,satirYuksekligi,15,METPTFEMIK)
	 	Elseif Trim(STKOD) >= "150_01_60_09_400"  and Trim(STKOD) <= "150_01_60_09_600"  Then	
			METPTFEKODU = STKOD
			METPTFEADI=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",METPTFEKODU,-1) 
			METPTFEMIK=Doc.NumFormat(MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i),15,0)   
			t=t+1
			tt = 202.5+t*4
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+tt,solmargin+88,satirYuksekligi,40,METPTFEKODU)
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+tt,solmargin+118.3,satirYuksekligi,60,METPTFEADI)
			res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+tt,solmargin+162,satirYuksekligi,15,METPTFEMIK)
 		 Else
			rr = 0	
		End IF
		STKAD = doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",STKOD,-1) 
Else
		HSURE = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR2(i)
		PSURE = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(i)
		TSURE = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)	
		TK = Mid(KODU,1,2)
			If TK = "KL" Then
				TKODU = KODU
	 	  End if
'*********************	
End If

	MAMNO = MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU(1)
	MAMGKD1=Trim(doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","GK_1",MAMNO,-1)) 
	MAMGKD =Mid(MAMGKD1,1,2)

	If KTIP = "I" AND KK = "K" Then 
		KALIPK = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
	End If
 
  If KTIP = "I" AND MAMGKD = "H1" AND OPKODU = "1_180" Then 
		OPTMIK = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
	Elseif KTIP = "I" AND MAMGKD = "H2" AND OPKODU = "3_100" Then 
		OPTMIK = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
	Elseif KTIP = "I" AND MAMGKD = "H4" AND OPKODU = "2_120" Then 
		OPTMIK = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
	Elseif KTIP = "I" AND MAMGKD = "H5" AND OPKODU = "6_150" Then
		OPTMIK = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
	End If

' ***************************************************************

' ORHAN - 2 -

	OPERASYON_ADI = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON_IMLT01_AD(i)
	
	IF TRIM(OPERASYON_ADI) = "PRES BASKI" THEN
			TEZGAHKODU = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HSURE = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR2(i) * 60
			PSURE = ((DOC.DIV(MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(i), MMPS10E.SF_PAKETICERIGI)) * RECETE1) * 60
			TSURE = HSURE + PSURE
	ELSEIF TRIM(OPERASYON_ADI) = "PROFÝL ÇEKME" THEN
			TEZGAHKODU = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HSURE = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR2(i) * 60
			PSURE = ((DOC.DIV(MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(i), MMPS10E.SF_PAKETICERIGI)) * RECETE1) * 60
			TSURE = HSURE + PSURE
	ELSEIF TRIM(OPERASYON_ADI) = "ENJEKSÝYON BASKI" THEN
			TEZGAHKODU = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HSURE = MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR2(i) * 60
			PSURE = ((DOC.DIV(MMPS10T.R_MIKTAR0(i), MMPS10E.SF_PAKETICERIGI)) * RECETE1) * 60
			TSURE = HSURE + PSURE	
	ELSE
			TEZGAHKODU = ""
			HSURE = ""
			PSURE = ""
			TSURE = ""
	END IF



	KTIP = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)
	KCODE = TRIM(LEFT(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i),2))
	If KTIP = "I" AND KCODE = "KL" Then 
		KALIPK = TRIM(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i))
		UZUN = RIGHT(KALIPK, 5)
		KALIPSAYISI = LEFT(UZUN,2)
		GOZSAYISI = RIGHT(UZUN, 3)
 	End If

	TOPM = MMPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR(1)
	NETA = Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(Doc.Div(HMIK,TOPM),25,3)
	MAXCAPAK = Doc.NumFormat(doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_2",MAMNO,""),23,2)
	MAXSAKAT = Doc.NumFormat(doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",MAMNO,""),23,2)

	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+45,solmargin+145,satirYuksekligi,100, TEZGAHKODU)
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+50,solmargin+145,satirYuksekligi,30,KALIPK)
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+57,solmargin+145,10,25,KALIPSAYISI & " / " & GOZSAYISI)
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+68,solmargin+145,10,25,Doc.NumFormat(OPTMIK,25,3))
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+92.5,solmargin+89,satirYuksekligi,25,NETA)
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+92,solmargin+119,10,15,MAXCAPAK)
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+92,solmargin+147,10,15,MAXSAKAT)
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+99,solmargin+145,satirYuksekligi,15,HMIK)
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+139,solmargin+145,satirYuksekligi,20,Doc.NumFormat(PSURE,18,3))
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+143,solmargin+145,satirYuksekligi,20,Doc.NumFormat(HSURE,18,3))
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+147,solmargin+145,satirYuksekligi,20,Doc.NumFormat(TSURE,18,3))

' ***************************************************************


End Sub

  For i=1 to rows 
	  aktif = Old.AKTIF_PASIF(i)
  		if aktif="*" then
			mamulmik= Trim(Old.MAMULMIKTAR(i))
		End if
	Next

	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("BOMU01T","BOMREC_CODE",MAMNO)
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_BOMU01T_SELECT")

  For i=1 to rows 
	  aktif = Old.AKTIF_PASIF(i)
	 	 if aktif="*" then
			operasyonkod= Trim(Old.BOMREC_OPERASYON(i))
		End if
		If MAMGKD = "H5" AND operasyonkod = "6_160" Then
			 operasyonmik= Old.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		Elseif  MAMGKD = "H1" AND operasyonkod = "1_200" Then
			 operasyonmik= Old.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		Elseif  MAMGKD = "H2" AND operasyonkod = "3_110" Then
			 operasyonmik= Old.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		Elseif  MAMGKD = "H4" AND operasyonkod = "2_120" Then
			 operasyonmik= Old.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(i)
		End If
  Next 
	
	vardiya = 11 * mamulmik
	VBIMALATKPSTS = Doc.Div(vardiya,operasyonmik)
		
	res = pe1.write(rBaslangic+120.5,solmargin+50,10,25,Doc.NumFormat(VBIMALATKPSTS,25,3))

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Satýþ Sipariþi",297,210,"LANDSCAPE")
	Bas=33
	Yan =10
	satirno=0
	toplam=0
	Ss=0
	satirpozr=Bas+20

	satirSayisi = STOK40T.GetRecCount()
	 
'******************
'	Ss = satirSayisi * 5

	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)

	For i=1 To satirSayisi 
				satirno=satirno+1
				satirpozr = satirpozr+5
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

If satirSayisi > 10 Then
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	res=pe1.pagebreak
	satirno=1
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirpozr=Bas+25
End If 
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)

'****	satirpozr= satirpozr + (satirno - 1) * 5
	
	skod = STOK40T.KOD(i)
 	sadi=STOK40T.KOD_STOK00_AD(i)

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,5,50,sadi) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+51,5,30,skod) 
	miktar=Doc.NumFormat0(STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(i),25,0)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+71,4,16,miktar)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	miktarbirim=STOK40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+88,4,8,miktarbirim)
	csipno=STOK40T.CHSIPANO(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+175,5,20,csipno)
	TTAR = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK40T.REV_RTESTARIH(i))
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+198,4,20,TTAR)
	pbrm = STOK40T.PRICEUNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+236,4,10,pbrm)
	bfiyat=Doc.NumFormat0(STOK40T.OR_FIYAT(i),25,2)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+247,4,19,bfiyat)
	snot = ""
	snot = Trim(STOK40T.NOTES(i))
 If snot <> "" Then
	satirpozr= satirpozr + 5
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,5,50,snot)
 else
 End If
	
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Satýþ Sipariþi",297,210,"LANDSCAPE")
	Bas = 33
	Yan = 10
	satirno = 0
	toplam = 0
	Ss = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirSayisi = STOK40T.GetRecCount()
	SatirBaslangic	 = 59
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)	
	sayfaSatirsayisi = 15
	satiryuksekligi = 5

	For i=1 To satirSayisi 
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	If siraNo >= sayfaSatirsayisi Then
		Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If i = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
	
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	skod = STOK40T.KOD(i)
 	sadi=STOK40T.KOD_STOK00_AD(i)

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,5,50,sadi) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+51,5,30,skod) 
	miktar=Doc.NumFormat0(STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(i),25,0)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+71,4,16,miktar)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	miktarbirim=STOK40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+88,4,8,miktarbirim)
	csipno=STOK40T.CHSIPANO(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+175,5,20,csipno)
	TTAR = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK40T.REV_RTESTARIH(i))
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+198,4,20,TTAR)
	pbrm = STOK40T.PRICEUNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+236,4,10,pbrm)
	bfiyat=Doc.NumFormat0(STOK40T.OR_FIYAT(i),25,2)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+247,4,19,bfiyat)
	snot = ""
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	snot = Trim(STOK40T.NOTES(i))
 If snot <> "" Then
	satirpozr= satirpozr + 5
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,5,50,snot)
 else
 End If
	
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	If siraNo >= sayfaSatirsayisi Then
		Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If i = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
	
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	skod = STOK40T.KOD(i)
 	sadi=STOK40T.KOD_STOK00_AD(i)

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,5,50,sadi) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+51,5,30,skod) 
	miktar=Doc.NumFormat0(STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(i),25,0)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+71,4,16,miktar)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	miktarbirim=STOK40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+88,4,8,miktarbirim)

'****************16/06/2006	

	stgk2=doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","GK_2",skod,"")
	stgk2ad = doc.GetGecoValue("STKGK2","AD",stgk2,-1) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+96,4,20,stgk2ad)
	
	stgk7=doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","GK_7",skod,"")
	stgk7ad = doc.GetGecoValue("STKGK7","AD",stgk7,-1) 


	msgbox stgk7ad
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+116,4,20,stgk7ad)

	
	kod=STOK40T.KOD(i)
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("BOMU01T", "BOMREC_CODE", kod) 
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_BOMU01T_SELECT")

	For k=1 to rows 
	aktif = Old.AKTIF_PASIF(k)

	if aktif="*" then
	kod = Old.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(k)
   	if Old.BOMREC_INPUTTYPE(k) = "I" and mid(kod,1,2) = "KL" Then 
	  skodu = kod
	  End if

	End if
	Next 

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+130.5,4,27,skodu)
	
	stndrt=doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00",skod,"STANDART",0)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+156,4,20,stndrt)

'******************************
	csipno=STOK40T.CHSIPANO(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+175,5,20,csipno)

	TTAR = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK40T.REV_RTESTARIH(i))
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+198,4,20,TTAR)
	pbrm = STOK40T.PRICEUNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+236,4,10,pbrm)
	bfiyat=Doc.NumFormat0(STOK40T.OR_FIYAT(i),25,2)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+247,4,19,bfiyat)
	snot = ""
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	snot = Trim(STOK40T.NOTES(i))
 If snot <> "" Then
	satirpozr= satirpozr + 5
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,5,50,snot)
 else
 End If
	
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"MPS Kartý",297,210,"")
	HAMURK = ""
	KALIPK = ""
	HMIK = 0
	HMIKBRM = ""
	k=0
	satirbaslangic=45
	satirno=0
	res=pe1.pensize(0.5)

	satirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i=1 To satirSayisi 				
	Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	KTIP=Trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i))

If KTIP = "H" Then	

	STKOD=MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
	STKGKD1=Trim(doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","GK_1",STKOD,-1)) 
	STGKD =Mid(STKGKD1,1,1)

 Select Case STGKD
   Case "G" 
	  HAMURK = STKOD 
	    HMIK=MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)   
		  HMIKBRM=MMPS10T.KAYNAK_BIRIM(i)	
	Case "C" 
	  KALIPK = STKOD 		
	Case Else
	  ST = STKOD
End Select	

	STKAD=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",STKOD,-1) 
	
End If

End Sub

Public satirbaslangic, satirSayisi, chkodu, satirno,k, HAMURK, KALIPK,HMIK, HMIKBRM, HAMURK1, HMIK1,BRM1, OPKODU, OPTMIK 
 
Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"MPS Kartý",297,210,"")
	HAMURK = ""
	KALIPK = ""
	HMIK = 0
	HMIKBRM = ""
	HAMURK1 = ""
	HMIK1 = 0
	HMIKBRM1 = ""
	OPKODU = ""
	OPTMIK = 0

	k=0
	satirbaslangic=45
	satirno=0
	res=pe1.pensize(0.5)

	satirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i=1 To satirSayisi 				
	Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	KTIP=Trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i))
	KODU = Trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i))
	OPKODU = Trim(MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(i))
	KK = Mid(KODU,1,1) 
	 If KTIP = "H" Then	

	STKOD=MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
	STKGKD1=Trim(doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","GK_1",STKOD,-1)) 
	STGKD =Mid(STKGKD1,1,1)
 Select Case STGKD
   Case "G" 
	  If HAMURK = "" THEN 
		 HAMURK = STKOD 
	    HMIK=MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)   
		  HMIKBRM=MMPS10T.KAYNAK_BIRIM(i)	
		ELSE
			HAMURK1 = STKOD 
	   	HMIK1=MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)   
		  HMIKBRM1=MMPS10T.KAYNAK_BIRIM(i)	
    END IF
'	Case "C" 
'	  KALIPK = STKOD 		
	Case Else
	  ST = STKOD
End Select	

	STKAD=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",STKOD,-1) 
	End If

	MAMNO = MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU(1)
	MAMGKD1=Trim(doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","GK_1",MAMNO,-1)) 
	MAMGKD =Mid(MAMGKD1,1,2)

	If KTIP = "I" AND KK = "K" Then 
		KALIPK = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
 		End If
 
  If KTIP = "I" AND MAMGKD = "H1" AND OPKODU = "1_180" Then 
		OPTMIK = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
	Elseif KTIP = "I" AND MAMGKD = "H2" AND OPKODU = "3_100" Then 
		OPTMIK = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
	Elseif KTIP = "I" AND MAMGKD = "H4" AND OPKODU = "2_120" Then 
		OPTMIK = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
	Elseif KTIP = "I" AND MAMGKD = "H5" AND OPKODU = "6_150" Then
		OPTMIK = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
 
		End If
 
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	satirno=1
	satirbaslangic=56 
	satirpozr=0
  SYuk = 4.3*2
	Satirsayisi = 0
	j = 1
	k = 0
	yan = 8
	ust= 3
	SS = 0
	SKd = " "
	
	bb=4*4.3
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
  res = pe1.Open(0,"Toplu MPS Emri",297,210,"LANDSCAPE")
'	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
'	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(33)
'	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(10)

 Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
 Satirsayisi = MMPS30T.GetRecCount()	 

	For i=1 To satirSayisi
		SEC = MMPS30T.SELECTED(i)
	If SEC = "E" Then    
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
		satirno=satirno+1
	End If
	Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)

'	MPSNo = MMPS30T.EVRAKNO(i)
	
'				res = pe1.PageBreak()
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

	If satirno = 25 Then
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	res=pe1.pagebreak
	satirno=1
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirbaslangic=56 
End If
	
	satirpozr= ust+satirbaslangic + (satirno - 1) * 5

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+1,5,6,satirno)
	MSTK = MMPS30T.MAMULSTOKKODU(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+9,5,30,MSTK)
	SGK2 = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_2",MSTK,-1)
	SGK2A = Doc.GetGecoValue("STKGK2","AD",SGK2,-1)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+39,5,25,SGK2A)
	HINO = MMPS30T.EVRAKNO(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+74,5,20,HINO)
	TMM = Doc.NumFormat_NLZ((MMPS30T.SF_BAKIYEMIKTAR(i)),25,3)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+112,5,20,TMM)
'	MUST = MMPS30T. MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_AD(i)
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+136,5,27,MUST)
'	TOPS = MMPS30T.TOTAL_OCT(1)
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+164,5,27,TOPS)
  TOPS=Doc.GetDbFieldValue("MMPS10E", "TOTAL_OCT", HINO, "")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+167,5,25,TOPS)
'	CKod = MPS10E. MUSTERIKODU(1)
'	CAD = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,-1)
'	res = pe1.Write(bb+syuk,174,SYuk,45,CAD)

End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

	If satirno = 24 Then
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	res=pe1.pagebreak
	satirno=1
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirbaslangic=56 
End If
	
	satirpozr= ust+satirbaslangic + (satirno - 1) * 5

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+1,5,6,satirno)
	MSTK = MMPS30T.MAMULSTOKKODU(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+9,5,30,MSTK)
	SGK2 = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_2",MSTK,-1)
	SGK2A = Doc.GetGecoValue("STKGK2","AD",SGK2,-1)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+39,5,25,SGK2A)
	HINO = MMPS30T.EVRAKNO(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+71,5,18,HINO)
	TMM = Doc.NumFormat_NLZ((MMPS30T.SF_BAKIYEMIKTAR(i)),25,3)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+124,5,19,TMM)
'	MUST = MMPS30T. MUSTERIKODU_CARI00_AD(i)
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+136,5,27,MUST)
'	TOPS = MMPS30T.TOTAL_OCT(1)
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+164,5,27,TOPS)

	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("BOMU01E", "MAMULCODE", MSTK) 
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_BOMU01E_SELECT")
	For k=1 to rows 
	aktif = Old.AKTIF_PASIF(k)
	if aktif="*" then
	ARMIK = Old.MAMULMIKTAR(k)
	End if
	Next 
	
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("BOMU01T", "BOMREC_CODE", MSTK) 
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_BOMU01T_SELECT")
	For l=1 to rows 
	aktif = Old.AKTIF_PASIF(l) 
	if aktif="*" and Trim(Old.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(l)) = "0002" then
	TS0 = Old.BOMREC_KAYNAK0(l)
	TS1 = Old.BOMREC_KAYNAK1(l)
	TS2 = Old.BOMREC_KAYNAK2(l)
	TS = TS0 + TS1 + TS2
	
	End if
	Next 
'  Msgbox TS

	UHPMIK = MMPS30T.NOTLAR_1(i)
	If UHPMIK > 0 Then 
	HIOTSURE = ARMIK * UHPMIK 
	End If
	TTS = TS * UHPMIK * 60
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+108,5,15,UHPMIK)
	TUHPMIK = TUHPMIK + UHPMIK
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+145,5,21,HIOTSURE)
	TGUNPMIK = TGUNPMIK + HIOTSURE
  TOPS=Doc.GetDbFieldValue("MMPS10E", "TOTAL_OCT", HINO, "")
'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+167,5,25,(Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(TOPS,25,3)))
	TOPTTS = TOPTTS + TTS 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr,yan+167,5,25,(Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(TTS,25,3)))
'	CKod = MPS10E. MUSTERIKODU(1)
'	CAD = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CKod,-1)
'	res = pe1.Write(bb+syuk,174,SYuk,45,CAD)

End Sub

Public satirbaslangic, satirSayisi, chkodu, satirno,k, HAMURK, KALIPK,HMIK, HMIKBRM, HAMURK1, HMIK1,BRM1, OPKODU, OPTMIK 
 
Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"MPS Kartý",297,210,"")
	HAMURK = ""
	KALIPK = ""
	HMIK = 0
	HMIKBRM = ""
	HAMURK1 = ""
	HMIK1 = 0
	HMIKBRM1 = ""
	OPKODU = ""
	OPTMIK = 0

	k=0
	satirbaslangic=45
	satirno=0
	res=pe1.pensize(0.5)

	satirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i=1 To satirSayisi 				
	Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	KTIP=Trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i))
	KODU = Trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i))
	OPKODU = Trim(MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(i))
	KK = Mid(KODU,1,1) 
	 If KTIP = "H" Then	

	STKOD=MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
	STKGKD1=Trim(doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","GK_1",STKOD,-1)) 
	STGKD =Mid(STKGKD1,1,1)
 Select Case STGKD
   Case "G" 
	  If HAMURK = "" THEN 
		 HAMURK = STKOD 
	    HMIK=MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)   
		  HMIKBRM=MMPS10T.KAYNAK_BIRIM(i)	
		ELSE
			HAMURK1 = STKOD 
	   	HMIK1=MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)   
		  HMIKBRM1=MMPS10T.KAYNAK_BIRIM(i)	
    END IF
'	Case "C" 
'	  KALIPK = STKOD 		
	Case Else
	  ST = STKOD
End Select	

	STKAD=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",STKOD,-1) 
	End If

	MAMNO = MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU(1)
	MAMGKD1=Trim(doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","GK_1",MAMNO,-1)) 
	MAMGKD =Mid(MAMGKD1,1,2)

 		End If

	Elseif KTIP = "I" AND MAMGKD = "H5" AND OPKODU = "6_150" Then

		End If
 
End Sub

Public satirbaslangic, satirSayisi, chkodu, satirno,k, HAMURK, KALIPK,HMIK, HMIKBRM, HAMURK1, HMIK1,BRM1, OPKODU, OPTMIK 
 
Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"MPS Kartý",297,210,"")
	HAMURK = ""
	KALIPK = ""
	HMIK = 0
	HMIKBRM = ""
	HAMURK1 = ""
	HMIK1 = 0
	HMIKBRM1 = ""
	OPKODU = ""
	OPTMIK = 0

	k=0
	satirbaslangic=45
	satirno=0
	res=pe1.pensize(0.5)

	satirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i=1 To satirSayisi 				
	Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	KTIP=Trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i))
	KODU = Trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i))
	OPKODU = Trim(MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(i))
	KK = Mid(KODU,1,1) 
	 If KTIP = "H" Then	

	STKOD=MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
	STKGKD1=Trim(doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","GK_1",STKOD,-1)) 
	STGKD =Mid(STKGKD1,1,1)
 Select Case STGKD
   Case "G" 
	  If HAMURK = "" THEN 
		 HAMURK = STKOD 
	    HMIK=MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)   
		  HMIKBRM=MMPS10T.KAYNAK_BIRIM(i)	
		ELSE
			HAMURK1 = STKOD 
	   	HMIK1=MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)   
		  HMIKBRM1=MMPS10T.KAYNAK_BIRIM(i)	
    END IF
'	Case "C" 
'	  KALIPK = STKOD 		
	Case Else
	  ST = STKOD
End Select

Public satirbaslangic, satirSayisi, chkodu, satirno, eurotoplam, tltoplam,kk,ust,yan
Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Satýnalma Sipariþi",297,210,"LANDSCAPE")

'	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
'	res = pe1.Open(0,"Baþlýk",-1,-1,"")
	ust = 13
	yan = 11
'***
	satirbaslangic=80
	satirno=0
	eurotoplam=0
	tltoplam=0
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	For i=1 To satirSayisi 
				satirno=satirno+1
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)
	If satirno = 18 Then
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	res=pe1.pagebreak
	satirno=1
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirbaslangic=80 
End If	

	satirpozr= satirbaslangic + (satirno - 1) * 5
	
	stokkodu=STOK46T.KOD(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,4,35,stokkodu)
	stokadi=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,-1) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+37,4,75,stokadi)
	not0=STOK46T.NOTE0(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+111,4,45,not0)
	miktar=Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(STOK46T.SF_MIKTAR(i),25,2)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+168,4,17,miktar)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	miktarbirim=STOK46T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+186,4,10,miktarbirim)
	fiyat=Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(STOK46T.OR_FIYAT(i),15,3)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+194,4,15,fiyat)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	parabirim=STOK46T.PRICEUNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+210.5,4,10,parabirim)
	tutar=Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(STOK46T.OR_TUTAR(i),15,3)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+221,4,21,tutar)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+242.3,4,10,parabirim)
	testar=Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46T.REV_RTESTARIH(i))
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+255,4,19,testar)

End Sub

End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

If satirSayisi > 5 Then
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	res=pe1.pagebreak
	satirno=1
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirpozr=Bas+25
End If 
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 7)
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)

'****	satirpozr= satirpozr + (satirno - 1) * 5
	
	skod = STOK40T.KOD(i)
 	sadi=STOK40T.KOD_STOK00_AD(i)

	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,5,50,sadi) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+51,5,30,skod) 
	miktar=Doc.NumFormat0(STOK40T.SF_MIKTAR(i),25,0)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+75,4,15,miktar)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	miktarbirim=STOK40T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+89,4,10,miktarbirim)
	pbrm = STOK40T.PRICEUNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+210,4,20,pbrm)
	bfiyat=Doc.NumFormat0(STOK40T.OR_FIYAT(i),25,0)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+251,4,19,bfiyat)
	snot = ""
	snot = Trim(STOK40T.NOTES(i))
 If snot <> "" Then
	satirpozr= satirpozr + 5
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,5,50,snot)
 else
 End If
	
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
Dim pe1
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
   res = pe1.Open(0,"Satýnalma Sipariþi",297,210,"LANDSCAPE")

'	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
'	res = pe1.Open(0,"Baþlýk",-1,-1,"")
	ust = 13
	yan = 11
'***
	satirbaslangic=80
	satirno=0
	eurotoplam=0
	tltoplam=0
	Call SayfaBasi(pe1)
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	For i=1 To satirSayisi 
				satirno=satirno+1
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1,i)
	Next
	Call SayfaSonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub
Sub SayfaBasi(pe1)
	kk=131
	res=pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.box(ust,yan,155,275)
	res = pe1.picture(ust,yan,13,55, "K:\D7K\@AS2007\images\LOGO.bmp",2)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 11)
	res = pe1.write(ust+1,110,5,125,"KALÝTE YÖNETÝMÝ SÝSTEMÝ DÖKÜMANTASYONU")
	res = pe1.write(ust+15,13,4,45,"Bölüm :          KSÝ")
	res = pe1.Setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(ust+10,yan+120,6,130,"SÝPARÝÞ MEKTUBU")
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	res = pe1.write(ust+2,yan+217,4,60,"Dök. No :  Ek-4/PRS-KSÝ-06-01 ")
	res = pe1.write(ust+8,yan+217,4,60,"Rev. No :           2        ")
	res = pe1.write(ust+14,yan+217,4,60,"Sayfa     :   ")
	sayfasayisi=pe1.GetPageCount()
	sayfano=pe1.GetCurrentPage()
	res = pe1.Write(ust+14,yan+238,5,30,sayfano&" "&"/"&" "&sayfasayisi)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
'******ust dik çizgiler********

	res = pe1.line(ust,yan+55,18,0)
	res = pe1.line(ust,yan+215,18,0)
'******ust yatay çizgiler******
	res = pe1.line(ust+6,yan+55,0,220)
	res = pe1.line(ust+12,yan+215,0,60)
	res = pe1.line(ust+18,yan,0,275)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.Setbold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+21,yan+4,5,50,"SATICI /ÝMALATÇI ADRESÝ")

	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	chkodu=STOK46E.CH_KODU(1)
	chadi1=doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","AD",chkodu,"") 
	chadi2=doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","NAME2",chkodu,"") 
	cadr1 = doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",chkodu,"") 
	cadr2 = doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",chkodu,"") 
	cadr3 = doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",chkodu,"") 

	res = pe1.write(ust+30,yan+4,4,100, chadi1)
'	res = pe1.write(ust+31,yan+4,4,100, chadi2)
'	res = pe1.write(ust+36,yan+4,4,100, chadr1)
'	res = pe1.write(ust+41,yan+4,4,100, chadr2)
'	res = pe1.write(ust+46,yan+4,4,100, chadr3)
	
	res = pe1.Setbold(1)
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+19.5,yan+125,5,40,"ÖDEME VE SEVK ADRESÝ")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+25,yan+115,5,50,"ARSAN KAUÇUK SAN. VE TÝC. A.Þ.")
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+29,yan+115,5,100,"Nato Yolu Yukarý Dudullu Organize Sanayi Bölgsi")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+33,yan+115,5,50,"81260 DUDULLU / ÝSTANBUL")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+37,yan+115,5,90,"Tel : 0216-365 83 06 Pbx.   Fax : 0216-365 83 16")
	res = pe1.Setbold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+41,yan+115,5,59,"Anadolu Kurumlar V.D. 0800037999")
'****YAN KUTULAR********
	res = pe1.box(ust+18,yan+225,13,50)
	res = pe1.box(ust+35,yan+225,13,50)

	res = pe1.line(ust+23,yan+225,0,50)
	res = pe1.line(ust+41.5,yan+225,0,50)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+19,yan+235,5,30,"Satýnalma Emri No")
	ENO = STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
	res = pe1.write(ust+25, yan+235,5, 25, ENO)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+36.5,yan+227,5,30,"Sipariþ Tarihi :")
	ETr = Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46E.TARIH(1))
	res = pe1.write(ust+36.5, yan+250,5, 25, ETr)

	res = pe1.Write(ust+43,yan+227,5,30,"Sayfa No :")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+43,yan+250,5,30,sayfano)

'****** Satýcý / Ýmalatçý *****************

'	res = pe1.line(ust+52,yan,0,275)
'	res = pe1.line(ust+56,yan,0,275)

	res = pe1.line(ust+52,yan+45,11,0)
	res = pe1.line(ust+52,yan+124,11,0)
	res = pe1.line(ust+52,yan+160,11,0)
	res = pe1.line(ust+52,yan+177,11,0)
	res = pe1.line(ust+52,yan+194,11,0)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.Setbold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+48,yan+93,5,90,"Bu kýsým Satýcý / Ýmalatçý tarafýndan doldurulacaktýr.")
'****	
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.box(ust+48,yan,15,275)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial",9)
	res = pe1.Setbold(1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(100,100,100))

	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	res = pe1.box(ust+52,yan,4,275)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(100,100,100))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+52,yan+18,5,20,"ONAYLAYAN")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+52,yan+73,5,29,"ÖDEME KOÞULU")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+52,yan+130,5,25,"NAKLÝYE FÝRMASI")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+52,yan+163,5,25,"KAPALI")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+52,yan+183,5,25,"AÇIK")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+52,yan+213,5,35,"AMBALAJ ÞEKLÝ")
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	ODKS = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)	
	res = pe1.Write(ust+57,yan+47,5,77,ODKS)
	NAKF = STOK46E.NAKLIYECIFIRMA(1)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+57,yan+125,5,35,NAKF)
	NAKK = STOK46E.NAKLIYEKOSULLARI(1)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+57,yan+195,5,78,NAKK)
	res = pe1.Write(ust+57,yan+167,5,5,"X")
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

'********satýr baþlýklarý**********************

'	res = pe1.line(ust+67,yan,0,275)

	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
	res = pe1.box(ust+63,yan,4,275)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(100,100,100))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,255,255))

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)

	res = pe1.Write(ust+63,yan+127,5,20,"AÇIKLAMA")
	res = pe1.Write(ust+63,yan+171,5,40,"Miktar (Ad.Kg)")

	res = pe1.Write(ust+63,yan+230,5,20,"TUTARI")

	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))

	res = pe1.line(ust+63,yan+36,92,0)
	res = pe1.line(ust+63,yan+100,92,0)
	res = pe1.line(ust+63,yan+168,92,0)
	res = pe1.line(ust+63,yan+194,92,0)
	res = pe1.line(ust+63,yan+220,92,0)
	res = pe1.line(ust+63,yan+252,92,0)


End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)
	If satirno = 18 Then
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	res=pe1.pagebreak
	satirno=1
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirbaslangic=80 
End If	

	satirpozr= satirbaslangic + (satirno - 1) * 5
	
	stokkodu=STOK46T.KOD(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,4,35,stokkodu)
	stokadi=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,-1) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+37,4,60,stokadi)
	not0=STOK46T.NOTE0(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+101,4,45,not0)
	miktar=Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(STOK46T.SF_MIKTAR(i),25,2)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+168,4,17,miktar)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	miktarbirim=STOK46T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+186,4,10,miktarbirim)
	fiyat=Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(STOK46T.OR_FIYAT(i),15,3)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+194,4,15,fiyat)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	parabirim=STOK46T.PRICEUNIT(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+210.5,4,10,parabirim)
	tutar=Doc.NumFormat_NLZ(STOK46T.OR_TUTAR(i),15,3)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+221,4,21,tutar)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+242.3,4,10,parabirim)
	testar=Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46T.REV_RTESTARIH(i))
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+255,4,19,testar)

End Sub


Sub SayfaSonu(pe1) 

'***************************ALT YAZILAR**************************

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial",9)	
	res = pe1.write(175,yan+10,4,25,"SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN :")
	res = pe1.write(175,yan+55,4,25,"E.ALPDOÐAN")
	res = pe1.write(175,yan+75,4,15,"ONAY")
	
	res = pe1.Setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(185,50,4,125, "SÝPARÝÞÝ ONAYLADIKTAN SONRA LÜTFEN GERÝ FAKSLAYINIZ!")
	
	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
	res = pe1.write(185,240,4,40,"Q.Form KSÝ-06-01.4")
	
End Sub

Sub Satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	
	res = pe1.Setbold(0)

	res = pe1.Selectfont("Arial", 9)
	If satirno = 18 Then
	Call sayfasonu(pe1)
	res=pe1.pagebreak
	satirno=1
	Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirbaslangic=80 
End If	

	satirpozr= satirbaslangic + (satirno - 1) * 5
	
	stokkodu=STOK46T.KOD(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+1,4,35,stokkodu)
	stokadi=doc.GetkartValue("STOK00","AD",stokkodu,-1) 
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+37,4,60,stokadi)
	not0=STOK46T.NOTE0(i)
	res = pe1.write(satirpozr+1,yan+100,4,40,not0)

Makro Kodu : ARSST63-01
Hangi Tablo için : STOK63

Kod : 
Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, SatirBitis
Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, ToplamProTutar
Public xCizgi()
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 43
	SolMargin = 14
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3
	satirBaslangic = 103.2
	satirsonu=180.6

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = STOK63T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)
	
	chkod=STOK60E.CH_KODU
	chad=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, "")
	chadres1=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, "")
	chadres2=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, "")
	chadres3=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, "")
	chvergid=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, "")
	chvergin=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, "")
	tarih=STOK60E.TARIH
	sevktarih=STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH
	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50, chkod)	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chad)	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres1)	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres2)	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres3)	
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7, solmargin+39, satiryuksekligi, 100, trim(chvergid)&"     "&trim(chvergin))


	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*6, solmargin+148, satiryuksekligi, 50, doc.strtonordate(tarih))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*8, solmargin+148, satiryuksekligi, 50, doc.strtonordate(sevktarih))



End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)

Dim satirpozr
		sol=solmargin
		If trim(STOK63T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir > satirSonu Then

			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi

			End If
		End If		
		
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)

				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK63T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))

				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					degisken=doc.numformat(degisken, grid(i,1), ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				Next
				
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		RINET = doc.GetUDFValue("RI",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"NET",0)
		RIBRUT = doc.GetUDFValue("RI",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"BRUT",0)
		RIADET = doc.GetUDFValue("RI",STOK60E.EVRAKNO,"ADET",0)
		res = pe1.write(181, SolMargin, satiryuksekligi, 195, "NET(Kg)              "&"     :" & "   " &RINET)
		res = pe1.write(185, SolMargin, satiryuksekligi, 195, "BRUT(Kg)            " & "    :" &"   " &RIBRUT)
		res = pe1.write(189, SolMargin, satiryuksekligi, 195, "AMBALAJ ADEDÝ   :"&"  " &RIADET)


	SVKU = Trim(STOK60E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1(1))
	If SVKU <> " " Then
		SVKA1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
		SVKA2 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
			res = pe1.write(193, SolMargin, satiryuksekligi, 195, "SEVK ADR           " & "   :" &"  "&SVKU&"  "&SVKA1)
			res = pe1.write(197, SolMargin, satiryuksekligi, 150, SVKA2)

	End If	 
		

End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(4,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 45
	Grid(1,1) = 80
	Grid(2,1) = 20
	Grid(3,1) = 15
	
	Grid(0,2) = "MAL CÝNSÝ"
	Grid(1,2) = "MAL ADI"
	Grid(2,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(3,2) = ""
	
		
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
			
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK63T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

Sub sayfabasi(pe1)

		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-15, 5, 65, chadres2)

		res=pe1.write(satirpoz, solmargin-15, 5, 65, chadres3)

	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+36, solmargin+13, 5,60, trim(chvergidairesi) & " / " &  trim(chvergino))
	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+25, solmargin+118, 5, 80, evrakno)

Sub satiryazdir(pe1, i)
	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",9)

	If sirano > 15 Then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		sirano=0
		Call sayfabasi(pe1)
	End If
	sirano=sirano+1
	satirpozr=satirbaslangic + (sirano-1) * satiryukseklik
	
	stokkodu=STOK70T.KOD(i)
	stokadi=Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu, "")
	miktar=doc.NumFormat(STOK70T.SF_MIKTAR(i), 20, 2)
	fiyat=doc.NumFormat(STOK70T.TL_FIYAT(i), 25, 0)
	birim=STOK70T.SF_SF_UNIT(i)
	tutar=doc.NumFormat(STOK70T.TL_TUTAR(i), 30, 0)
	sipno=STOK70T.SIPNO(i)
	chsipno=Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO",sipno,  "")
	aciklama=STOK70T.NOTES(i)
	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",8)
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-28, satiryukseklik, 19, chsipno) 
'	If Left(trim(aciklama), 1)="-" Then
'		aciklama1=mid(aciklama, 2, 1)
'		stokkodu1=STOK70T.KOD(aciklama1)
'		stokadi1=trim(Doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK00", "AD", stokkodu1, ""))
'		If len(trim(StokAdi1)) > 30 Then
'			StokAdi1 = left(StokAdi1,30)
'		End If
'		res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-6, satiryukseklik, 74, trim(stokadi) & " (" & trim(stokadi1) & ")") 
'		res= pe1.write(satirpozr+6, satirsolmargin-10, satiryukseklik, 100, "(" & stokadi1 &")") 
'	Else
'		res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin-6, satiryukseklik, 74, stokadi) 
'	End If
	res=pe1.Selectfont("Arial",9)
	res= pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin , satiryukseklik, 33,stokkodu ) 
	res= pe1.write(satirpozr, satirsolmargin + 35, satiryukseklik, 60,stokadi)
