Kod : 
Public ustmargin, solmargin, sagMargin, satirYuksekligi, sirano
Dim sayfaSatirsayisi, AraToplam, Grid, satirSonu, satirBaslangic
Dim solTutar, GenTutar, solPB, GenPB, xCizgi(), sayfaSatirPozr, solTLTutar, GenTLTutar
Sub PrintForm()
		
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	Set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fatura", sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, "")

	satirYuksekligi = 4.3

	Redim xCizgi(0)

	Ustmargin = 2 * satirYuksekligi
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 17 * satirYuksekligi

	solmargin = 6
	sagMargin = SayfaEni - 6
	satirpozr = 0

	sayfaSatirsayisi = 30
	sirano = 0
	sayfaSatirPozr = UstMargin + 9 * satirYuksekligi
	CKSN23T.SafePack

	satirSayisi = CKSN23T.GetRecCount
	Call Alanlar()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	satirPozr = 63
	SatirSonu = 260
	SonSatir = 0
	Sutuny = 63
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Firma = Doc.Customp_GetS("FNAMEL0")
	res = pe1.Setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin, solMargin, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, trim(Firma))
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 6, solMargin, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "Ç E K   Ý A D E   B O R D R O S U")

	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))

	CHKodu = CKSN23E.CIKISCODE
	Unvan1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "AD", CHKodu, "")
	Unvan2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "NAME2", CHKodu, "")
	Adres1 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", CHKodu, "")
	Adres2 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", CHKodu, "")
	Adres3 = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", CHKodu, "")
	VergiDairesi = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", CHKodu, "")
	VergiNo = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("CARI00", "VERGINO", CHKodu, "")

	BBasla = 30
	KutuEn = 100
	res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 1, 5, KutuEn, CHKodu)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Unvan1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Unvan2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Adres1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Adres2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, Adres3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, KutuEn, "Vergi Dairesi : " & VergiDairesi & " Vergi No : " & VergiNo)

	res = pe1.Box(BBasla - 2, solMargin, pe1.GetBottom - BBasla + 2, KutuEn + 2)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(sayfaSatirPozr + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 136, 10, 20, "TARÝH")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN23E.TARIH))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 136, 10, 20, "BORDRO NO")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & trim(CKSN23E.EVRAKNO))

	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.Setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i, 1)
		Baslik = Grid(i, 2)
		res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 3 * satirYuksekligi, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(uBound(XCizgi)) = sol - 1
		Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(XCizgi) + 1)
	Next
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
	If trim(CKSN23T.E_CKSNNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i, 1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i, 0)				
		if degiskenAdi = "_BANKASUBE" then
			Degisken = trim(CKSN23T.E_BANKA(satirNo)) & " / " & trim(CKSN23T.E_SUBE(satirNo))
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_SEHIR" then
			Degisken = Doc.GetGecoValue("SEHIR","AD",CKSN23T.E_SEHIR(satirNo),-1)
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "_CEKHESAPNO" then
			Degisken = trim(CKSN23T.E_OREVRAKNO(satirNo)) & " / " & trim(CKSN23T.E_HESAPNO(satirNo))
		else
			Degisken = CKSN23T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi, SatirNo)
		end if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		if degiskenAdi = "E_OR_TUTAR" then
			solTutar = sol
			GenTutar = SutunGenisligi
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "E_TL_TUTAR" then
			solTLTutar = sol
			GenTLTutar = SutunGenisligi
		Elseif degiskenAdi = "E_OR_KUR" then
			solPB = sol
			GenPB = SutunGenisligi
		end if
		If Grid(i, 4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i, 6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18, Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i, 4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)			
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub PrintFormSayfaSonu(pe1)
	satirUst = satirBaslangic -  4 * satirYuksekligi
	satirSonu = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))
	res = pe1.box(satirUst, SolMargin, satirSonu - satirUst, SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - satirYuksekligi, SolMargin, 0, SagMargin - SolMargin)

'dikey çizgiler
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) - 2
		LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		If lineX = 0 Then Exit For
		if i <> 6 then
			res = pe1.Line(satirUst, LineX, satirSonu - satirUst, 0)
		end if
	Next

	sBAsla = satirSonu + satirYuksekligi
	res = pe1.line(sBAsla, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	ToplamTutar = CKSN23E.TL_TOPLAMTUTAR

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 1, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "TOPLAM ADET")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 30, ": "& CKSN23T.GetRecCount)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "BORDRO TOPLAMI")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 8, 2, ":")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	ToplamBasla = pe1.GetTop
	Set ToplamTable = BordroToplamTable()
	if ToplamTable.GetRecCount = 1 Then
	 	res = pe1.Write(ToplamBasla, solTutar, 5, GenTutar - 2, Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTable.E_OR_TUTAR(1),20,Grid(6,6)))
	 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solPB, 5, GenPB - 2, ToplamTable.E_OR_KUR(1))
	Else
		ToplamBasla = ToplamBasla - satirYuksekligi
		for i = 1 to ToplamTable.GetRecCount
		 	res = pe1.Write(ToplamBasla + (i-1) * satirYuksekligi, solTutar, 5, GenTutar - 2, Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTable.E_OR_TUTAR(i),20,Grid(6,6)))
		 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solPB, 5, GenPB - 2, ToplamTable.E_OR_KUR(i))
		Next
	End if
 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solTLTutar, 5, GenTLTutar - 2, Doc.NumFormat(ToplamTutar,20,Grid(8,6)))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	PB = Doc.DefaultPB
' 	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solPB, 5, 20, Doc.DefaultPB)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 30, "ORTALAMA VADE")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(CKSN23E.ORTALAMARVALOR))

	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)

	Yalniz = Doc.NumToText_TL(ToplamTutar)
	if trim(PB) = trim(Doc.DefaultPB) then
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, sagMargin - solMargin, "YALNIZ " & Yalniz & " hesabýnýza borç kaydedilmiþtir.")
	end if

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 2 * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 52, "YETKÝLÝ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 75, 5, 52, "DÜZENLEYEN")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 139, 5, 52, "TESLÝM ALAN")
	alt = pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + 4 * satirYuksekligi, solMargin + 1, 5, 52, "LÜTFEN FAKSLAYINIZ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, solmargin + 139, 5, 52, "ÖDEMEYÝ EKSÝKSÝZ")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 52, "TESLÝM ALDIM")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 52, "KAÞE - ÝMZA")

	res = pe1.PenColor(RGB(180, 180, 180))

	res = pe1.line(alt, solMargin + 1, 0, 40)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 75, 0, 40)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetTop, solMargin + 139, 0, 40)
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8, 7)

	Grid(0, 0) = "E_CKSNNO"
	Grid(1, 0) = "E_KESIDECI"
	Grid(2, 0) = "_BANKASUBE"
	Grid(3, 0) = "_SEHIR"
	Grid(4, 0) = "_CEKHESAPNO"
	Grid(5, 0) = "E_RVADE"
	Grid(6, 0) = "E_OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(7, 0) = "E_OR_KUR"
	Grid(8, 0) = "E_TL_TUTAR"

	Grid(0, 1) = 12
	Grid(1, 1) = 37
	Grid(2, 1) = 34
	Grid(3, 1) = 19
	Grid(4, 1) = 24
	Grid(5, 1) = 17
	Grid(6, 1) = 26
	Grid(7, 1) = 8
	Grid(8, 1) = 20

	Grid(0, 2) = "ÇEK NO"
	Grid(1, 2) = "KEÞÝDECÝ"
	Grid(2, 2) = "BANKA / ÞUBE"
	Grid(3, 2) = "ÞEHÝR"
	Grid(4, 2) = "BANKA ÇEK / HESAP NO"
	Grid(5, 2) = "VADE TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(6, 2) = "TUTARI"
	Grid(7, 2) = ""
	Grid(8, 2) = "YTL TUTAR"

	Grid(0, 4) = "C"
	Grid(1, 4) = "C"
	Grid(2, 4) = "C"
	Grid(3, 4) = "C"
	Grid(4, 4) = "C"
	Grid(5, 4) = "D"
	Grid(6, 4) = "N"
	Grid(7, 4) = "C"
	Grid(8, 4) = "N"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid, 1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i, 0)
		If Grid(i, 4) = "N" Then
			ondalik = CKSN23T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i, 6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Grid(6, 6) = 2
	Grid(8, 6) = 2
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	for i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(sayfaSatirPozr, solMargin + 136, 5, 20, "SAYFA")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 5, 25, ": " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount)
	Next
End Sub
Function BordroToplamTable()
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=CKSN23T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set C10T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set CK10T = Doc.GetTableObject("CKSN23T")
	C10T.CopyTable(CK10T)
	C10T.GroupBy2("E_OR_KUR")
	Set BordroToplamTable = C10T
End Function

Public Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo
Sub PrintLabel()
	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 6
	EtiketBoyu = 130
	EtiketEni = 198
	EtiketlerArasi = 145
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket" & trim(STOK19E.EVRAKNO),sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)

	solMargin = 6
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 6
	For i = 1 to STOK19T.GetRecCount()
		if trim(STOK19T.KOD(i)) <> "" and trim(STOK19T.KOD(i)) <> "HURDA" then
			Miktar = STOK19T.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
			StokKodu = STOK19T.KOD(i)
			EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1
			if EtiketNo mod 2 = 1 then
				Ust = UstMargin
				if EtiketNo <> 1 then
					res = pe1.PageBreak()
				end if
			else
				Ust = UstMargin + EtiketlerArasi
			end if
			Call Etiket(pe1,i)
		end if
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo)
' dikey çizgilerin yerleri
	D1 = SolMargin + 43
	D2 = SolMargin + 83.5
	D3 = SolMargin + 124

'yatay çizgilerin yerleri
	Ara = 19
	Y1 = Ust + 25
	Y2 = Ust + 52
	Y3 = Y2 + Ara
	Y4 = Y3 + Ara
	Y5 = Y4 + Ara
	Y6 = Y4 + Ara
	Alt = Ust + EtiketBoyu
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Box(Ust,SolMargin, EtiketBoyu, sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Line(Y1,SolMargin,0,D2 - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y2,SolMargin,0,D2 - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3,SolMargin,0,D2 - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4,SolMargin,0,D2 - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y5,SolMargin,0,D2 - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y6,SolMargin,0,D2 - SolMargin)
'	for i = 1 to 4
'		res = pe1.Line(Y3 + i * 4.4,D2,0,sagMargin-D2)
'	Next
	res = pe1.Line(Y3,D1,Y4-Y3,0)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")

	sol = solMargin
	sag = D2
	rUst = Y4

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 1.5, sol + 2.5,5,sag - sol - 2.5,"Parça Adý :")

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.Write(rUst + 6, sol,8,sag - sol,trim(STOK19T.KOD_STOK00_AD(satirNo)))

	sol = d1

	rUst = Y3
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)

Public satir, satirBaslangic, SatirSonu, En
Public Grid, SolMargin, ToplamTotalWeight, ToplamMiktar
Dim xCizgi(10)
Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	ReDim Grid(1)
	satir = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	En = 0
	ToplamTotalWeight = 0
	ToplamMiktar = 0
	SolMargin = 10
		Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Çeki Listesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

		If doc.ErrorNumber Then
			MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		siraNo = 0        
		satirSayisi_tableT = STOK19T.GetRecCount()
		Call Alanlar
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
		Next	
		Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
		Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
		res = pe1.Show()
		res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)	
		Basla = 40
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 12)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Write(Basla,SolMargin,6,En,"ÇEKÝ LÝSTESÝ")

		Not1 = STOK19E.NOTES_1(1)
		Not2 = STOK19E.NOTES_2(1)

		CHKodu = STOK19E.CHKODU(1)
		If trim(STOK19E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1(1)) <> "" Then
			Unvan1 = STOK19E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1(1)
			Unvan2 = STOK19E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_2(1)
		Else
			Unvan1 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CHKodu,-1)
			Unvan2 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",CHKodu,-1)
		End If
		If trim(STOK19E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)) <> "" Then
			Adres1 = STOK19E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
			Adres2 = STOK19E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
			Adres3 = STOK19E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
		Else
			Adres1 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CHKodu,-1)
			Adres2 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,-1)
			Adres3 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,-1)			
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 10)
		Tel = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","TELEFONNO_1",CHKodu,-1)
		Fax = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","FAXNO",CHKodu,-1)

		kutuUst = Basla + 6

		res = pe1.Write(Basla + 10,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Not1)

		satir = Basla + 12
		If trim(Unvan1) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Unvan1)
		End If
		If trim(Unvan2) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Unvan2)
		End If
		If trim(Adres1) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Adres1)
		End If
		If trim(Adres2) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Adres2)
		End If
		If trim(Adres3) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Adres3)
		End If
		If trim(Tel) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,15,"Tel")
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 17,6,En,": " & Tel)
		End If
		If trim(Fax) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,15,"Fax")
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 17,6,En,": " & Fax)
		End If
		
		kutuAlt = Satir + 8	
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.6)
		res = pe1.Box(KutuUst, SolMargin,KutuAlt-KutuUst,En)
	
		satir = satir + 10
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin,6,En,trim(Not2))

		res = pe1.SetItalic(1)

		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) - 1 		
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			res = pe1.write(Satir + 6, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 4 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		Next
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		satirBaslangic = satir + 18
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
		If trim(STOK19T.KOD(SatirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		satiryuksekligi = 6
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		satirSonu = 270
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
				Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
				siraNo = 1
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				Call Print_form_arasayfalar(pe1)
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
				If satirNo = 1 Then
						satirpozr = satirBaslangic
				Else
						satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
				End If
				siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 10)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  
				If left(Grid(i,0),1) <> "_" Then
					DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK19T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
					If grid(i,0) = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
						ToplamMiktar = ToplamMiktar + STOK19T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
					End If
				Else
					StokKodu = STOK19T.KOD(SatirNo)
					If Grid(i,0) = "_ORGREFNO" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0U","UCODE",StokKodu & "000001","")
					ElseIf Grid(i,0) = "_NETWEIGHT" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_2",StokKodu ,"")
					ElseIf Grid(i,0) = "_TOTALWEIGHT" Then
						BirimAgirlik = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_2",StokKodu ,"")
						Miktar = STOK19T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
						Degisken = BirimAgirlik * Miktar
						ToplamTotalWeight = ToplamTotalWeight + Degisken
					End If
				End If
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,3) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,4)
					Degisken = SayiBicimle(Degisken, Ondalik, 1, 1)
				Elseif Grid(i,3) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
				j = j + 1
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'dýþ çerçeve
		res = pe1.box(SatirBaslangic - 13.5, SolMargin, SatirSonu - SatirBaslangic + 17, En)
		res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 1.5, SolMargin, 0, En)

'dikey çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		  res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 13.5, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 17, 0)
		Next
End Sub
Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
		sayfaSonu = pe1.GetBottom()
'dýþ çerçeve
		res = pe1.box(SatirBaslangic - 13.5, SolMargin, SayfaSonu - SatirBaslangic + 21, En)
		res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 1.5, SolMargin, 0, En)
		res = pe1.Line(SayfaSonu + 1.5, SolMargin, 0, En)

'dikey çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
			If i >= 3 Then
			  res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 13.5, LineX, SayfaSonu - satirBaslangic + 21, 0)
			Else
			  res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 13.5, LineX, SayfaSonu - satirBaslangic + 15, 0)
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)		
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaSonu + 2, xCizgi(2)+2,6,Grid(3,1)-4,"Toplam")
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		ToplamMiktar = SayiBicimle(ToplamMiktar, 0, 1, 1)
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaSonu + 2, xCizgi(3)+2,6,Grid(4,1)-4,ToplamMiktar)
		ToplamTotalWeight = SayiBicimle(ToplamTotalWeight, 2, 1, 1)
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaSonu + 2, xCizgi(5)+2,6,Grid(6,1)-4,ToplamTotalWeight)

		Call Agirliklar(pe1)

End Sub
Sub Agirliklar(pe1)

Dim Packing
	ReDim Packing(1)
	For i = 1 To STOK19T.GetRecCount()
		If trim(STOK19T.KOD(i)) = "" Then Exit For
		Pack = STOK19T.PACKNO_1(i)	
		If i = 1 Then
			Packing(UBound(Packing)-1) = Pack
		ElseIf i>1 And Pack <> Packing(UBound(Packing)-1) Then
			ReDim Preserve Packing(UBound(Packing)+1)
			Packing(UBound(Packing)-1) = Pack
		End If
	Next
	ReDim Paket(UBound(Packing),4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Packing)-1
		Paket(i,0) = Packing(i)
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Paket,1)-1
		For j = 1 To STOK19T.GetRecCount()
			If trim(STOK19T.KOD(j)) = "" Then Exit For
			Pck = STOK19T.PACKNO_1(j)
			If Pck = Paket(i,0) Then
				StokKodu = STOK19T.KOD(j)
				NetAgirlik = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_2",StokKodu ,"")
				PMiktar = STOK19T.SF_MIKTAR(j)
				ToplamNet = ToplamNet + (NetAgirlik * PMiktar)
				PaketMiktar = PaketMiktar + PMiktar
				Varyant = STOK19T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(	j)
				If trim(Varyant) <> "" Then
					Palet = Varyant
				End If
			End If
		Next
		Paket(i,1) = ToplamNet
		Paket(i,2) = Palet
		Paket(i,3) = PaketMiktar
		PaketMiktar = 0
		ToplamNet = 0
	Next
	
	Dip = pe1.GetBottom() + UBound(Paket,1) * 6 + 35

	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 10
	If Dip > SatirSonu Then
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		SonSatir = 83
		Call Print_form_baslik(pe1)
	End If
'baþlýklar

	ReDim Grid2(5,2)
	Grid2(0,1) = 20
	Grid2(1,1) = 65
	Grid2(2,1) = 35
	Grid2(3,1) = 35
	Grid2(4,1) = 35


	For i = 0 To 4
		EnGrid2 = EnGrid2 + Grid2(i,1)
	Next

	Sol2 = (210 - EnGrid2) / 2

	Dim xCizgi2(4)
	xCizgi2(0) = Sol2 + Grid2(0,1)
	xCizgi2(1) = xCizgi2(0) + Grid2(1,1)
	xCizgi2(2) = xCizgi2(1) + Grid2(2,1)
	xCizgi2(3) = xCizgi2(2) + Grid2(3,1)

	UstKose = SonSatir + 15
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.8)
	res = pe1.Box(UstKose - 13,Sol2,13,EnGrid2)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman", 14)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(UstKose - 9,Sol2,6,EnGrid2,"ÖZET LÝSTE")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman", 12)
	res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
	res = pe1.Write(SonSatir + 17,Sol2,6,Grid2(0,1),"Paket No") 
	SolDim = Sol2 + Grid2(0,1) 
	res = pe1.Write(SonSatir + 17,SolDim,6,Grid2(1,1),"Boyutlar (cm)") 
	SolGross = SolDim + Grid2(1,1)
	res = pe1.Write(SonSatir + 17,SolGross,6,Grid2(2,1) + Grid2(3,1),"Aðýrlýk (kg)") 
	res = pe1.Write(SonSatir + 24,SolGross,6,Grid2(2,1),"Brüt") 
	SolNet = SolGross + Grid2(2,1)
	res = pe1.Write(SonSatir + 24,SolNet,6,Grid2(3,1),"Net") 
	SonSatir1 = pe1.GetBottom()
	SolMiktar = SolNet + Grid2(3,1)
	res = pe1.Write(SonSatir + 17,SolMiktar,6,Grid2(4,1),"Toplam Adet") 
	res = pe1.SetItalic(0)

	
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Paket,1) - 1
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(SonSatir1+1 + i * 6, Sol2+2,6,Grid2(0,1)-8,trim(Paket(i,0)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Paket(i,2) <> "" Then
			Palet = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","AD",Paket(i,2),"")
		Else
			Palet = ""
		End If
		res = pe1.Write(SonSatir1+1 + i * 6, SolDim + 2,6,Grid2(1,1)-4,Palet)
		PaletAgirligi = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_2",Paket(i,2),"")
		BrutAgirlik = Paket(i,1) + PaletAgirligi
		TotalBrut = TotalBrut + BrutAgirlik
		BrutAgirlik = SayiBicimle(BrutAgirlik,2,1,1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(SonSatir1+1 + i * 6, SolGross + 2,6,Grid2(2,1)-4,BrutAgirlik)
		TotalNet = TotalNet + Paket(i,1)
		NetAgirlik = SayiBicimle(Paket(i,1),2,1,1)		
		res = pe1.Write(SonSatir1+1 + i * 6, SolNet + 2,6,Grid2(3,1)-4,NetAgirlik)
		TotalMiktar = TotalMiktar + Paket(i,3)
		PkMiktar = SayiBicimle(Paket(i,3),0,1,1)
		res = pe1.Write(SonSatir1+1 + i * 6, SolMiktar + 2,6,Grid2(4,1)-4,PkMiktar)
	Next

		SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		TotalBrut = SayiBicimle(TotalBrut,2,1,1)
		TotalNet = SayiBicimle(TotalNet,2,1,1)
		TotalMiktar = SayiBicimle(TotalMiktar,0,1,1)

		res = pe1.SelectFont("Times New Roman",12)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(SonSatir+1, Sol2 + 2,6,Grid2(0,1) + Grid2(1,1)-4,"GENEL TOPLAM")
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(SonSatir+1, SolGross + 2,6,Grid2(2,1)-4,TotalBrut)
		res = pe1.Write(SonSatir+1, SolNet + 2,6,Grid2(3,1)-4,TotalNet)
		res = pe1.Write(SonSatir+1, SolMiktar + 2,6,Grid2(4,1)-4,TotalMiktar)

		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()

'		res = pe1.PenSize(0.6)
		res = pe1.Box(UstKose, Sol2, EnAlt - UstKose + 2, EnGrid2)
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.4)
		For i = 0 To UBound(Paket,1)
			res = pe1.Line(UstKose + 16 + i*6 ,Sol2, 0, EnGrid2)
		Next
		res = pe1.Line(UstKose + 8,xCizgi2(1), 0, xCizgi2(3)-xCizgi2(1))
		For i = 0 To 3
			If i = 2 Then
				res = pe1.Line(UstKose + 8, xCizgi2(i), EnAlt - UstKose - 6, 0)
			Elseif i=0 Then
				res = pe1.Line(UstKose, xCizgi2(i), EnAlt - UstKose - 7, 0)
			Else
				res = pe1.Line(UstKose, xCizgi2(i), EnAlt - UstKose + 2, 0)
			End If
		Next
End Sub
Sub Print_form_baslik(pe1)
		Basla = 40
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 12)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Write(Basla,SolMargin,6,En,"ÇEKÝ LÝSTESÝ")

		Not1 = STOK19E.NOTES_1(1)
		CHKodu = STOK19E.CHKODU(1)
		If trim(STOK19E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1(1)) <> "" Then
			Unvan1 = STOK19E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1(1)
			Unvan2 = STOK19E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_2(1)
		Else
			Unvan1 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CHKodu,-1)
			Unvan2 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",CHKodu,-1)
		End If
		If trim(STOK19E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)) <> "" Then
			Adres1 = STOK19E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
			Adres2 = STOK19E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
			Adres3 = STOK19E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
		Else
			Adres1 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CHKodu,-1)
			Adres2 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,-1)
			Adres3 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,-1)			
		End If
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 10)

		kutuUst = Basla + 6

		res = pe1.Write(Basla + 10,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Not1)

		satir = Basla + 12
		If trim(Unvan1) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Unvan1)
		End If
		If trim(Unvan2) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Unvan2)
		End If
		If trim(Adres1) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Adres1)
		End If
		If trim(Adres2) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Adres2)
		End If
		If trim(Adres3) <> "" Then
			satir = satir + 6	
			res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin + 2,6,En,Adres3)
		End If

		kutuAlt = Satir + 8	
		res = pe1.PenSize(0.6)
		res = pe1.Box(KutuUst, SolMargin,KutuAlt-KutuUst,En)

		satir = satir + 10
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(satir,SolMargin,6,En,trim(Not2))

		satirBaslangic = satir + 18
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	SayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()	
	For i = 1 To SayfaSayisi
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.WriteRTF(60,160,6,30,"\b1 Sayfa   :   \b0 " & i & "  /  " & SayfaSayisi)
	Next
End Sub
Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,5)
	Grid(0,0) = "PACKNO_1"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "_ORGREFNO"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(5,0) = "_NETWEIGHT"
	Grid(6,0) = "_TOTALWEIGHT"
	Grid(0,1) = 10
	Grid(1,1) = 35
	Grid(2,1) = 45
	Grid(3,1) = 35
	Grid(4,1) = 18
	Grid(5,1) = 22
	Grid(6,1) = 25
	Grid(0,2) = "Pkg #"
	Grid(1,2) = "Parça Kodu"
	Grid(2,2) = "Açýklama"
	Grid(3,2) = "Orj. Parça No"
	Grid(4,2) = "Miktar"
	Grid(5,2) = "Net Aðýrlýk (kg)"
	Grid(6,2) = "Brüt Aðýrlýk (kg)"
	Grid(0,3) = "N"
	Grid(1,3) = "C"
	Grid(2,3) = "C"
	Grid(3,3) = "C"
	Grid(4,3) = "N"
	Grid(5,3) = "N"
	Grid(6,3) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = 2
	Grid(6,4) = 2

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,3)="N" And left(Grid(i,0),1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = DecimalHesapla(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,4) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)-1
			En = En + Grid(i,1)
	Next	
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
	If trim(sayi) = "" Then sayi = 0
	If trim(Ondaliksayisi) = "" Then Ondaliksayisi = 0

	If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
		Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
	End If
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		ondalik = ""
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
	End If
	TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
	If SondaSifir > 0 Then
		ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
	ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
		ondalik = ondalik
	Else
		ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
	End If
	If Ayirac = 1 Then
		TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
	End If
	If ondalik = "" Then
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi
	Else
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
	End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	If OndalikHane - Len(Sayi) > 0 Then
		SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
	Else
		SifirEkle = Sayi
	End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
	Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
	While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
		Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
	Wend
	SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
	If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	k = Len(Sayi)
	For i = 0 To k - 1
		If i > 0 And i Mod 3 = 0 Then
			Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
		End If
		Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
	Next
	VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
	End If
End Function
Function DecimalHesapla(Degisken)
k = 0
DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To STOK19T.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(STOK19T.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
DecimalHesapla = k
End Function
Function NumerikMi(DegiskenAdi)
	For i = 1 To STOK19T.GetRecCount()
		k = Table.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
		If Not(Isnumeric(k)) Then
			NumerikMi = 0
			Exit For
		End If
	NumerikMi=1
	Next
End Function

	StokKodu = STOK19T.KOD(1)
	Degisken = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_2",StokKodu ,"")
	msgbox degisken
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	ReDim Grid(1)
	satir = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	En = 0
	ToplamTotalWeight = 0
	ToplamMiktar = 0
	SolMargin = 10
		Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
		res = pe1.Open(0, "Packing List", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")

		If doc.ErrorNumber Then
			MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
			Exit Sub
		End If
		siraNo = 0        
		satirSayisi_tableT = STOK19T.GetRecCount()
		Call Alanlar
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
		Next	
		Call EnSonSayfa(pe1)
		Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
		res = pe1.Show()
		res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr, satiryuksekligi
		If trim(STOK19T.KOD(SatirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		satiryuksekligi = 6
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		satirSonu = 280
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
				Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
				siraNo = 1
				res = pe1.PageBreak()
				Call Print_form_arasayfalar(pe1)
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
				If satirNo = 1 Then
						satirpozr = satirBaslangic
				Else
						satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
				End If
				siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If
		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 10)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)  
				If left(Grid(i,0),1) <> "_" Then
					DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK19T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
					If grid(i,0) = "SF_MIKTAR" Then
						ToplamMiktar = ToplamMiktar + STOK19T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
					End If
				Else
					StokKodu = STOK19T.KOD(SatirNo)
					If Grid(i,0) = "_ORGREFNO" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0U","UCODE",StokKodu & "000001","")
					ElseIf Grid(i,0) = "_AD2" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK00","NAME2",StokKodu,"")
					ElseIf Grid(i,0) = "_NETWEIGHT" Then
						Degisken = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_2",StokKodu ,"")
					ElseIf Grid(i,0) = "_TOTALWEIGHT" Then
						BirimAgirlik = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_2",StokKodu ,"")
						Miktar = STOK19T.SF_MIKTAR(SatirNo)
						Degisken = BirimAgirlik * Miktar
						ToplamTotalWeight = ToplamTotalWeight + Degisken
					End If
				End If
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,3) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,4)
					Degisken = SayiBicimle(Degisken, Ondalik, 1, 1)
				Elseif Grid(i,3) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				xCizgi(j) =	Sol - 2
				j = j + 1
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()

End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)

'dýþ çerçeve
		res = pe1.box(SatirBaslangic - 13.5, SolMargin, SatirSonu - SatirBaslangic + 17, En)
		res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 1.5, SolMargin, 0, En)

'dikey çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
		  res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 13.5, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 17, 0)
		Next
End Sub
Sub EnSonSayfa(pe1)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.6)
		sayfaSonu = pe1.GetBottom()
'dýþ çerçeve
		res = pe1.box(SatirBaslangic - 13.5, SolMargin, SayfaSonu - SatirBaslangic + 21, En)
		res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 1.5, SolMargin, 0, En)
		res = pe1.Line(SayfaSonu + 1.5, SolMargin, 0, En)

'dikey çizgiler
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) -1
		  LineX = cint(xCizgi(i))
			If i >= 3 Then
			  res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 13.5, LineX, SayfaSonu - satirBaslangic + 21, 0)
			Else
			  res = pe1.Line(SatirBaslangic - 13.5, LineX, SayfaSonu - satirBaslangic + 15, 0)
			End If
		Next
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)		
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaSonu + 2, xCizgi(2)+2,6,Grid(3,1)-4,"Total")
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		ToplamMiktar = SayiBicimle(ToplamMiktar, 0, 1, 1)
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaSonu + 2, xCizgi(3)+2,6,Grid(4,1)-4,ToplamMiktar)
		ToplamTotalWeight = SayiBicimle(ToplamTotalWeight, 2, 1, 1)
		res = pe1.Write(SayfaSonu + 2, xCizgi(5)+2,6,Grid(6,1)-4,ToplamTotalWeight)

		Call Agirliklar(pe1)

End Sub
Sub Agirliklar(pe1)

Dim Packing
	ReDim Packing(1)
	For i = 1 To STOK19T.GetRecCount()
		If trim(STOK19T.KOD(i)) = "" Then Exit For
		Pack = STOK19T.PACKNO_1(i)	
		If i = 1 Then
			Packing(UBound(Packing)-1) = Pack
		ElseIf i>1 And Pack <> Packing(UBound(Packing)-1) Then
			ReDim Preserve Packing(UBound(Packing)+1)
			Packing(UBound(Packing)-1) = Pack
		End If
	Next
	ReDim Paket(UBound(Packing),4)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Packing)-1
		Paket(i,0) = Packing(i)
	Next
	For i = 0 To UBound(Paket,1)-1
		For j = 1 To STOK19T.GetRecCount()
			If trim(STOK19T.KOD(j)) = "" Then Exit For
			Pck = STOK19T.PACKNO_1(j)
			If Pck = Paket(i,0) Then
				StokKodu = STOK19T.KOD(j)
				NetAgirlik = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_2",StokKodu ,"")
				PMiktar = STOK19T.SF_MIKTAR(j)
				ToplamNet = ToplamNet + (NetAgirlik * PMiktar)
				PaketMiktar = PaketMiktar + PMiktar
				Varyant = STOK19T.SF_VRI_VR_R1(	j)
				If trim(Varyant) <> "" Then
					Palet = Varyant
				End If
			End If
		Next
		Paket(i,1) = ToplamNet
		Paket(i,2) = Palet
		Paket(i,3) = PaketMiktar
		PaketMiktar = 0
		ToplamNet = 0
	Next
	
	Dip = pe1.GetBottom() + UBound(Paket,1) * 6 + 30

	SonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + 10
	If Dip > SatirSonu Then

	Grid(6,0) = "_TOTALWEIGHT"

	Grid(1,1) = 35
	Grid(2,1) = 45
	Grid(3,1) = 35
	Grid(4,1) = 18
	Grid(5,1) = 22
	Grid(6,1) = 25
	Grid(0,2) = "Pkg #"
	Grid(1,2) = "Item"
	Grid(2,2) = "Description"
	Grid(3,2) = "Orig. Ref No"
	Grid(4,2) = "Qty"

	Grid(6,2) = "Total Weight (kg)"
	Grid(0,3) = "N"
	Grid(1,3) = "C"
	Grid(2,3) = "C"
	Grid(3,3) = "C"
	Grid(4,3) = "N"
	Grid(5,3) = "N"
	Grid(6,3) = "N"

	Grid(6,4) = 2

		If Grid(i,3)="N" And left(Grid(i,0),1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)

		End If
	Next

			En = En + Grid(i,1)

End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function FontAyarla(BasilacakAlan,ToplamGen,Font)
	Oran = BasilacakAlan / ToplamGen
	If Oran >= 1 Then
		FontAyarla = Font
	Else
		If oran <=0.8 Then
			FontAyarla = Round(0.8 * Font,0)
		Else
			FontAyarla = Round(Oran * Font,0)
		End If
	End If
End Function
Function SayiBicimle(Sayi, OndalikSayisi, SondaSifir, Ayirac)
	If trim(sayi) = "" Then sayi = 0
	If trim(Ondaliksayisi) = "" Then Ondaliksayisi = 0

	If OndalikSayisi >= 0 Then
		Sayi = Round(Sayi, OndalikSayisi)
	End If
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		ondalik = ""
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
	End If
	TamSayi = CStr(Fix(Sayi))
	If SondaSifir > 0 Then
		ondalik = SifirEkle(ondalik, OndalikSayisi)
	ElseIf SondaSifir = -1 Then
		ondalik = ondalik
	Else
		ondalik = SifirSil(ondalik)
	End If
	If Ayirac = 1 Then
		TamSayi = VirgulEkle(TamSayi)
	End If
	If ondalik = "" Then
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi
	Else
		SayiBicimle = TamSayi & "." & ondalik
	End If
End Function
Function SifirEkle(Sayi, OndalikHane)
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	If OndalikHane - Len(Sayi) > 0 Then
		SifirEkle = Sayi & String(OndalikHane - Len(Sayi), "0")
	Else
		SifirEkle = Sayi
	End If
End Function
Function SifirSil(Sayi)
	Sayi = Trim(CStr(Sayi))
	While Right(Sayi, 1) = "0"
		Sayi = Left(Sayi, Len(Sayi) - 1)
	Wend
	SifirSil = Sayi
End Function
Function VirgulEkle(Sayi)
	If Sayi = 0 Then Exit Function
	Sayi = CStr(Sayi)
	k = Len(Sayi)
	For i = 0 To k - 1
		If i > 0 And i Mod 3 = 0 Then
			Sagdan = "," & Sagdan
		End If
		Sagdan = Mid(Sayi, k - i, 1) & Sagdan
	Next
	VirgulEkle = Sagdan
End Function
Function DecimalSayisi(Sayi)
	sayi = Cstr(Sayi)
	Nokta = InStr(1, Sayi, ".")
	If Nokta = 0 Then
		DecimalSayisi = 0
	Else
		ondalik = Right(CStr(Sayi), Len(CStr(Sayi)) - Nokta)
		DecimalSayisi = len(SifirSil(Ondalik))
	End If
End Function
Function DecimalHesapla(Degisken)
k = 0
DecCount = 0
	For i=1 To STOK19T.GetRecCount()
		DecCount = DecimalSayisi(STOK19T.GetFieldValue(Degisken,i))
		If DecCount >= k Then
			k = DecCount
		End If
	Next
DecimalHesapla = k
End Function
Function NumerikMi(DegiskenAdi)
	For i = 1 To STOK19T.GetRecCount()
		k = Table.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,i)
		If Not(Isnumeric(k)) Then
			NumerikMi = 0
			Exit For
		End If
	NumerikMi=1
	Next
End Function

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	UstMargin = 60
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 6
	
	satirBaslangic = 120
	satirsonu=altmargin-90
	gen=0
	toplamnet=0
	toplambrut=0
	toplamc2=0
	toplamc1=0
	toplammik=0
	
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Malzeme Listesi",  SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni,"")
	
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = STOK19T.GetRecCount()
	
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

		toplamc2=toplamc2+c2

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(11,6)

	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = ""
	Grid(2,0) = ""
	Grid(3,0) = ""
	Grid(4,0) = ""
	Grid(5,0) = ""
	Grid(6,0) = ""
	Grid(7,0) = ""
	Grid(8,0) = ""
	Grid(9,1) = ""
	Grid(10,1)= ""
 

	
	Grid(0,1) = 22
	Grid(1,1) = 60
	Grid(2,1) = 15
	Grid(3,1) = 12
	Grid(4,1) = 20
	Grid(5,1) = 10
	Grid(6,1) = 17
	Grid(7,1) = 20
	Grid(8,1) =	12	
	Grid(9,1) = 16
	Grid(10,1)= 17

	Grid(0,2) = ""
	Grid(1,2) = ""
	Grid(2,2) = ""
	Grid(3,2) = ""
	Grid(4,2) = ""
	Grid(5,2) = ""
	Grid(6,1) = ""
	Grid(7,1) = ""
	Grid(8,1) =	""	
	Grid(9,1) = ""
	Grid(10,1)= ""

	
		
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"
	Grid(8,4) = "C"
	Grid(9,1) = "N"
	Grid(10,1)= "N"

	
	FOR i=0 to ubound(grid,1)
	gen=gen+grid(i,1)	
	next
		
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
		ondalik = STOK47T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
		Grid(i,6) = Ondalik					
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub

End Sub

End Sub

Public EndenEtiketSayisi,BoydanEtiketSayisi,EtiketEni, EtiketBoyu, EndenBosluk, BoydanBosluk
Public i,j, xOffset, yOffset, x, y
Sub PrintForm()
        On Error Resume Next
		
		 Etiket
        
        If doc.ErrorNumber Then
                MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
                Exit Sub
        End If
        
         FormOlustur()
End Sub

Sub Etiket()
        EtiketTuru = InputBox("Sayfa Türünü Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "Enden Etiket Sayýsý x Boydan Etiket Sayýsý" & _
					Chr(13) & "(Örnek : 3x5 gibi)" , "Dinamo","2x7")

        EtiketBoyutlari = InputBox("Etiket Boyutlatýný Giriniz" & Chr(13) & "Etiket Eni(mm) x Etiket Boyu(mm)" & _
					Chr(13) & "(Örnek : 99x57 gibi)" , "Dinamo","99.1x38.1")

		Boy=Len(EtiketTuru)
		Carpi=instr(ucase(EtiketTuru),"X")
		EndenEtiketSayisi=cint(trim(Left(EtiketTuru,Carpi-1)))
		BoydanEtiketSayisi=cint(trim(Mid(EtiketTuru,Carpi+1,Boy-Carpi)))

		Boy=Len(EtiketBoyutlari)
		Carpi=instr(ucase(EtiketBoyutlari),"X")
		EtiketEni=cint(trim(Left(EtiketBoyutlari,Carpi-1)))
		EtiketBoyu=cint(trim(Mid(EtiketBoyutlari,Carpi+1,Boy-Carpi)))

		EndenBosluk = 2.5
		BoydanBosluk = 0
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
    
	cHKodu = ADRESLER.KOD(SatirNo)
	cHAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",cHKodu,-1)
	cHAd2 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",cHKodu,-1)
	
'	Adi = doc.GetUDFValue("07",cHKodu,"ILGILI01",0)
	Adi = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","KONTAKTNAME_1",cHKodu,-1)

	Adres1 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",cHKodu,-1)
	Adres2 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",cHKodu,-1)
	Adres3 = Doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",cHKodu,-1)

	xAd = 42+ (x-1)*xOffset
	xAdres = 20+ (x-1)*xOffset

	SatirAraligi = 5
	ySayin = 14 + (y-1)*yOffset
	yAd = 20+ (y-1)*yOffset
	ySirketAdi = 24+ (y-1)*yOffset
	If trim(cHAd2) ="" Then
		ySirketAdi2 = ySirketAdi
	Else
		ySirketAdi2 = ySirketAdi + 6
	End If	
	yAdres1 = ySirketAdi2 + 7 
	yAdres2 = yAdres1 + SatirAraligi 
	yAdres3 = yAdres2 + SatirAraligi 

	res=pe1.setbold(1)
'	res=pe1.Write(ySayin, xAd, 7, 55, "Sayýn")		
	res=pe1.selectfont("Arial",11)

	res=pe1.Write(yAd, xAd-20, 7, 95, "Sayýn  "& Adi)		

	res=pe1.Write(ySirketAdi, xAdres, 7, 80, cHAdi)		
	If trim(cHAd2) <> "" Then
		res=pe1.Write(ySirketAdi2, xAdres, 7, 80, cHAd2)		
	End If
	
	res=pe1.setbold(0)
	res=pe1.selectfont("Arial",10)
			
	res=pe1.Write(yAdres1, xAdres, 7, 80,Adres1)
	res=pe1.Write(yAdres2, xAdres, 7, 80,Adres2)
	res=pe1.Write(yAdres3, xAdres, 7, 80,Adres3)
End Sub

Sub FormOlustur()
On Error Resume Next
Dim pe1, sayfa
      Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
      res = pe1.Open(0,"Adresler",-1,-1,"")
		
		satirSayisi=ADRESLER.GetRecCount()
		
		sayfaSayisi = basilacakSatir / (EndenEtiketSayisi * BoydanEtiketSayisi)
		If sayfaSayisi = fix(sayfaSayisi) Then
			sayfaSayisi = fix(sayfaSayisi) 
		Else
			sayfaSayisi = fix(sayfaSayisi) + 1
		End If
		
		xOffset = EtiketEni + EndenBosluk
		yOffset = EtiketBoyu + BoydanBosluk
				
        
			x=1
			y=1
			For i=1 To satirSayisi
				kod=ADRESLER.KOD( i)				
				akt = ADRESLER.SELECTED(i)
				If akt = "E" And trim(kod) <> "" Then
					res = pe1.nopen()
					Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)					
					sayi=sayi+1
					x=x+1							
					If x=EndenEtiketSayisi+1 Then
						x=1
						y=y+1
					End If							
				End If
				If y = BoydanEtiketSayisi+1  Then
				   res = pe1.PageBreak()
					x=1
					y=1
				End If
       Next
       res = pe1.Show()
       res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	ustmargin = 43
	SolMargin = 5
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3

'	satirBaslangic = 98.9
'	satirsonu=206.4

	satirBaslangic = 98.9 - satiryuksekligi*4
	satirsonu = satirBaslangic + satiryuksekligi*35

	toplamtutar=0
	toplammiktar=0
	soltutar=solmargin-4
	solmiktar=solmargin-4
	tut = 0	

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(2)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = STOK70T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	sol=solmargin+6
	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)
		res=pe1.setbold(1)
		res=pe1.setalign("left")
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 8, Sol+35, 10, SutunGenisligi - 1 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		Next
	res=pe1.setbold(0)

	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU
	chad=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, "")
	chadres1=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, "")
	chadres2=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, "")
	chadres3=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, "")

	chvergin=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, "")
	tarih=STOK70E.TARIH
	irsno=STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	irstarih=doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK60E", "TARIH", irsno, "")
		
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50, chkod)	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chad)	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres1)	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres2)	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres3)

'	res=pe1.setbold(0)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 50, chkod)	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 80, chad)	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi, solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres1)	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres2)	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres3)	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*5, solmargin+40, satiryuksekligi, 65, trim(chvergid)&" "&chvergin)	

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi, solmargin+150, satiryuksekligi, 50, doc.strtonordate(tarih))

End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
		res=pe1.selectfont("Courier new",7)

			sipno=STOK70T.SIPNO(satirno)

Dim satirpozr
		sol=solmargin
		If trim(STOK70T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then

'			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
				res=pe1.selectfont("Courier new",7)

			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi

			End If
		End If		
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				if degiskenadi="SEVKPAKETLOTNO" then
						SKOD = STOK70T.SEVKPAKETLOTNO(SatirNo)
						degisken=Mid(SKOD,1,7)
'						degisken=doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO", sipno, "")
				else
			
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK70T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
					end if
				if degiskenadi="OR_TUTAR" then
						toplamtutar=toplamtutar+degisken
				elseif degiskenadi="SF_MIKTAR" then
						toplammiktar=toplammiktar+degisken
				end if

				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				If degiskenadi= "OR_TUTAR" then
					Ondalik = 2
					Else
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				End If
					degisken=doc.numformat_nlz(degisken, grid(i,1), ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				Next
				
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "SEVKPAKETLOTNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "NOTES"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 19
	Grid(1,1) = 50
	Grid(2,1) = 39
	Grid(3,1) = 20
	Grid(4,1) = 26
	Grid(5,1) = 29
	for i=0 to 3
			soltutar=soltutar+grid(i,1)
	next
	for i=0 to 1
			solmiktar=solmiktar+grid(i,1)
	next

	Grid(0,2) = ""
	Grid(1,2) = ""
	Grid(2,2) = "PCS"
	
	Grid(3,2) = STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	GRid(3,2)=grid(3,2)&"/PCS"
	Grid(4,2) = STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
		
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
			
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK70T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Function yazi(geneltoplamyazi)
	if instr(1, geneltoplamyazi, "%")=0 then
	geneltoplamyazi=geneltoplamyazi&" "&"YTL"
	Else
	geneltoplamyazi=replace(geneltoplamyazi, "%"," "&"YTL"&" ",1)&" "&"Ykr"
	END if
end function

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, SatirBitis
Public AlanSayisi(), ToplamTutar, Toplammiktar,tut
Public xCizgi(), soltutar, solmiktar
Public Secilenler()
Public Grid()

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	ustmargin = 43
	SolMargin = 5
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3

'	satirBaslangic = 98.9
'	satirsonu=206.4

	satirBaslangic = 98.9 - satiryuksekligi*4
	satirsonu = satirBaslangic + satiryuksekligi*35

	toplamtutar=0
	toplammiktar=0
	soltutar=solmargin-4
	solmiktar=solmargin-4
	tut = 0	

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(2)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage(66)
	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)

	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni,"")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = STOK70T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	sol=solmargin+6
	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)
		res=pe1.setbold(1)
		res=pe1.setalign("left")
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
			Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 8, Sol+35, 10, SutunGenisligi - 1 , Baslik)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		Next
	res=pe1.setbold(0)

	chkod=STOK70E.CH_KODU
	chad=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, "")
	chadres1=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, "")
	chadres2=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, "")
	chadres3=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, "")
	chvergid=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, "")
	chvergin=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, "")
	tarih=STOK70E.TARIH
	irsno=STOK70T.IRSALIYENO(1)
	irstarih=doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK60E", "TARIH", irsno, "")
		
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 50, chkod)	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chad)	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres1)	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres2)	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres3)	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*7, solmargin+35, satiryuksekligi, 65, trim(chvergid)&" "&chvergin)	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin+145, satiryuksekligi, 50, doc.strtonordate(tarih))
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin+145, satiryuksekligi, 50, irsno)
'	res=pe1.setbold(1)
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*5, solmargin+145, satiryuksekligi, 90,doc.strtonordate(tarih))
'	res=pe1.setbold(0)

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin - satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 50, chkod)	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 80, chad)	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi, solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres1)	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres2)	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*3, solmargin+5, satiryuksekligi, 80, chadres3)	
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi*5, solmargin+40, satiryuksekligi, 65, trim(chvergid)&" "&chvergin)	

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi, solmargin+150, satiryuksekligi, 50, doc.strtonordate(tarih))
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*2, solmargin+150, satiryuksekligi, 50, irsno)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin+satiryuksekligi*4, solmargin+150, satiryuksekligi, 90,doc.strtonordate(tarih))
	res = pe1.setbold(0)




End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
		res=pe1.selectfont("Courier new",7)

			sipno=STOK70T.SIPNO(satirno)

Dim satirpozr
		sol=solmargin
		If trim(STOK70T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then

'			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
				res=pe1.selectfont("Courier new",7)

			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi

			End If
		End If		
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				if degiskenadi="SEVKPAKETLOTNO" then
						SKOD = STOK70T.SEVKPAKETLOTNO(SatirNo)
						degisken=Mid(SKOD,1,7)
'						degisken=doc.getdbfieldvalue("STOK40E", "CHSIPNO", sipno, "")
				else
			
				Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK70T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
					end if
				if degiskenadi="OR_TUTAR" then
						toplamtutar=toplamtutar+degisken
				elseif degiskenadi="SF_MIKTAR" then
						toplammiktar=toplammiktar+degisken
				end if

				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				If degiskenadi= "OR_TUTAR" then
					Ondalik = 2
					Else
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				End If
					degisken=doc.numformat_nlz(degisken, grid(i,1), ondalik)
				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				End If
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
			
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				Next
				
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	son=pe1.getbottom()+satiryuksekligi

	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'		If sonSatir >= 141.9 Then
	If sonSatir >= 176.3 Then
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
				Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res=pe1.selectfont("Courier new",7)
		son=pe1.getbottom()+satiryuksekligi*9

		End If


	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK70T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set S70T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set S70 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK70T")
	S70T.CopyTable(S70)
	S70T.GroupBy("SF_SF_UNIT")
	S70T.SORT("SF_SF_UNIT")

	ONdalik1=2
	ONdalik2=STOK70T.MAXSIGDIG("SF_MIKTAR")

    son=pe1.getbottom()+satiryuksekligi
		isktutar=doc.div(STOK70E.TL_ISKONTO1TOPLAMI, STOK70T.KUR(1))
		isko=doc.div(isktutar, toplamtutar)*100
		genelt=doc.div(STOK70E.TL_KDVDAHILTOPLAM, STOK70T.KUR(1))
		tut = 	genelt - isktutar
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	If isktutar > 0 Then
		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*2, soltutar, satiryuksekligi, grid(4,1), "%"&doc.numformat(isko,8,2)&" "&"Ýsk")
		End If

		res=pe1.setalign("right")
		res=pe1.line(son, soltutar+34, 0, grid(4,1)-4)
		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi, soltutar+29, satiryuksekligi, grid(4,1), doc.numformat(toplamtutar, grid(4,1), 2))
		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*2, soltutar+25, satiryuksekligi, grid(4,1), doc.numformat(isktutar, grid(4,1), 2))
		res=pe1.line(son, solmiktar+25, 0, grid(2,1)-4)
	
'		res=pe1.line(son+satiryuksekligi*4, soltutar+34, 0, grid(4,1)-4)
		for z=1 to S70T.getreccount()
		tmiktar=S70T.SF_MIKTAR(Z)
		birim=Trim(S70T.SF_SF_UNIT(Z))
			If birim = "Ad." Then
			birim = "Pcs"
			End If
		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*z, solmiktar+27, satiryuksekligi, grid(2,1), doc.numformat(tmiktar, grid(2,1), ondalik2)&" "&birim)
		NEXT
  If isktutar > 0 Then
		res=pe1.line(son+satiryuksekligi*4, soltutar+35, 0, grid(4,1)-4)
		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*5, soltutar+35, satiryuksekligi, grid(4,1), doc.numformat(tut, grid(4,1), ondalik1))
  End If
		Fob = doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70T.EVRAKNO,"FOB",0)
		sigorta = doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70T.EVRAKNO,"SIGORTA",0)
		navlun = doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70T.EVRAKNO,"NAVLUN",0)
		cif=fob+sigorta+navlun
		TOPLAMP = doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70T.EVRAKNO,"TOPLAMP",0)
		KUTU = doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70T.EVRAKNO,"KUTU",0)
		NETKG = doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70T.EVRAKNO,"NETKG",0)
		BRUTKG = doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70T.EVRAKNO,"BRUTKG",0)
		ARACIBANK = doc.GetUDFValue("FT",STOK70T.EVRAKNO,"ARACIBANK",0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	
'		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*6, solMARgin+30, satiryuksekligi, 2, ":")
'				res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*6, solMARgin, satiryuksekligi, 50, "FOB")
'		res=pe1.setalign("right")

'		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*6, solMARgin+30, satiryuksekligi, 20, doc.numfORMat(genelt,12,2))
'		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*6, solMARgin+45, satiryuksekligi, 20, STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))

'		if sigorta>0 then
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

'		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*7, solMARgin, satiryuksekligi, 50, "INSURANCE")
'		res=pe1.setalign("right")
'		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*7, solMARgin+30, satiryuksekligi, 2, ":")

'		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*7, solMARgin+30, satiryuksekligi, 20, doc.numformat(sigorta,12,3))
'		end if
'		if navlun>0 then
'		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
'		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*8, solMARgin, satiryuksekligi, 50, "FREIGHT")
'		res=pe1.setalign("right")
'		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*8, solMARgin+30, satiryuksekligi, 2, ":")
'		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*8, solMARgin+30, satiryuksekligi, 20, doc.numformat(navlun,12,3))

'		if sigorta> 0 or navlun>0 then

		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*10, solMARgin, satiryuksekligi, 50, "CIF")
		res=pe1.setalign("right")
		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*10, solMARgin+30, satiryuksekligi, 2, ":")

 		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*10, solMARgin+30, satiryuksekligi, 20,doc.numformat(tut,12,2))
 		res = pe1.write(son+satiryuksekligi*10, solMARgin+60, satiryuksekligi, 13,STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1))

'		end if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(5,7)

	Grid(0,0) = "SEVKPAKETLOTNO"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "NOTES"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(5,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	
	Grid(0,1) = 19
	Grid(1,1) = 50
	Grid(2,1) = 39
	Grid(3,1) = 20
	Grid(4,1) = 26
	Grid(5,1) = 29
	for i=0 to 3
			soltutar=soltutar+grid(i,1)
	next
	for i=0 to 1
			solmiktar=solmiktar+grid(i,1)
	next

	Grid(0,2) = ""
	Grid(1,2) = ""
	Grid(2,2) = "PCS"
	
	Grid(3,2) = STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	GRid(3,2)=grid(3,2)&"/PCS"
	Grid(4,2) = STOK70T.PRICEUNIT(1)
		
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
			
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1) 
		Degisken = Grid(i,0)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			
			ondalik = STOK70T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
			
		End If
	Next	
	For i = 0 To uBound(Grid,1) - 1
		ToplamEn = ToplamEn + Grid(i,1)
	Next
End Sub
Function yazi(geneltoplamyazi)
	if instr(1, geneltoplamyazi, "%")=0 then
	geneltoplamyazi=geneltoplamyazi&" "&"YTL"
	Else
	geneltoplamyazi=replace(geneltoplamyazi, "%"," "&"YTL"&" ",1)&" "&"Ykr"
	END if
end function

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	ToplamEURTutar = 0
	ToplamEURIskonto	= 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 25
	SolMargin = 15
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 210
	satirSonu = AltMargin - 30

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "BORDRO", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	res = pe1.selectfont(Arial,9)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin, solmargin + 150,satiryuksekligi,40,"FORM 7-2(1)")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + satiryuksekligi, solmargin + 146,satiryuksekligi,40,"Türkiye Ýþ Kurumu")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 2 * satiryuksekligi, solmargin + 148,satiryuksekligi,40,"Ýþgücü Çizelgesi")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 3 * satiryuksekligi + 1, solmargin + 10,satiryuksekligi,40,"ÝÞYERÝ NUMARASI")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 3 * satiryuksekligi + 1, solmargin + 80,satiryuksekligi,40,"AY:")
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 3 * satiryuksekligi + 1, solmargin + 135,satiryuksekligi,40,"YIL:")

	res = pe1.line(ustmargin + 3 * satiryuksekligi, solmargin,0,sagmargin -solmargin)
	res = pe1.line(ustmargin + 4 * satiryuksekligi, solmargin,0,sagmargin -solmargin)
	res = pe1.line(ustmargin + 8 * satiryuksekligi + 1, solmargin,0,sagmargin -solmargin)

	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom, solmargin + 5,4,50,"ADRES:")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom, solmargin + 5,4,50,"TELEFON:")
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop, solmargin + 85,4,50,"FAKS:")

	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop, solmargin + 85,4,50,"WEB ADRESÝ")

	Isyeri = PERSB45E.IY_BILDIRGENO(1)
	Unvan = PERSB45E.IY_UNVAN(1)

	Web = doc.getdbfieldvalue("PERSB01","IY_EMAIL2",Isyeri,"")

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 4 * satiryuksekligi + 1, solmargin + 60,4,100,trim(Unvan))

	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom, solmargin + 30,4,50,Trim(Adres))	
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom, solmargin + 30,4,50,Telefon)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop, solmargin + 100,4,50,Faks)
	res = pe1.write(pe1.getbottom, solmargin + 30,4,50,trim(Mail))
	res = pe1.write(pe1.gettop, solmargin + 110,4,50,trim(Web))
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	Donem = PERSB45E.AY(1)
	Yil = PERSB45E.YIL(1)
	if Donem = "01" then
		Donem = "OCAK"
	Elseif Donem = "02" then
		Donem = "ÞUBAT"
	Elseif Donem = "03" then
		Donem = "MART"
	Elseif Donem = "04" then
		Donem = "NÝSAN"
	Elseif Donem = "05" then
		Donem = "MAYIS"
	Elseif Donem = "06" then
		Donem = "HAZÝRAN"
	Elseif Donem = "07" then
		Donem = "TEMMUZ"
	Elseif Donem = "08" then
		Donem = "AÐUSTOS"
	Elseif Donem = "09" then
		Donem = "EYLÜL"
	Elseif Donem = "10" then
		Donem = "EKÝM"
	Elseif Donem = "11" then
		Donem = "KASIM"
	Elseif Donem = "12" then
		Donem = "ARALIK"
	End if

	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 3 * satiryuksekligi + 1, solmargin + 95,satiryuksekligi,40,Donem)
	res = pe1.write(ustmargin + 3 * satiryuksekligi + 1, solmargin + 150,satiryuksekligi,40,Yil)

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 20
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 20
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 25
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satiryuksekligi2 = 4
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 70
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSB39T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(PERSB39T.PERSONELSICILNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi2
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi2
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = PERSB39T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

					If DegiskenAdi = "DOGUM_TARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
 					If DegiskenAdi = "ISEGIRISTARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
					

					'If DegiskenAdi = "SIGORTASICILNO" then 
									
						'Uzunluk = Len(trim(Degisken))
						'For j = 1 to Uzunluk
							'DegiskenChar = mid(trim(Degisken),j,1)
							'res = pe1.write(satirpozr,sol + j*5.1 , satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, DegiskenChar)
						'Next
					'End if	

				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)

				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next				

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "AD_SOYAD"
	Grid(1,0) = "BABA_ADI"
	Grid(2,0) = "DOGUM_TARIHI"
	Grid(3,0) = "CINSIYET"
	Grid(4,0) = "EK1GOREVKODU"
	Grid(5,0) = "ISEGIRISTARIHI"
	Grid(6,0) = "EK1SGKK"
	Grid(7,0) = "SIGORTASICILNO"

	Grid(0,1) = 50
	Grid(1,1) = 28
	Grid(2,1) = 24
	Grid(3,1) = 19
	Grid(4,1) = 17
	Grid(5,1) = 20
	Grid(6,1) = 19
	Grid(7,1) = 74

	Grid(0,2) = "ADI SOYADI         (4)"
	Grid(1,2) = "BABA   (5)"
	Grid(2,2) = "DOÐUM TARÝHÝ (6)"
	Grid(3,2) = "CÝNSÝYETÝ E/K (7)"
	Grid(4,2) = "GÖREV KODU (8)"
	Grid(5,2) = "ÝÞE GÝRÝÞ TARÝHÝ(9)"
	Grid(6,2) = "SOS.GÜV KODU(10)"
	Grid(7,2) = "SÝCÝL NO (11)"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "D"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 20
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 20
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 25
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satiryuksekligi2 = 4
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 70
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSB39T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(PERSB39T.PERSONELSICILNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi2
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi2
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = PERSB39T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

					If DegiskenAdi = "DOGUM_TARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
 					If DegiskenAdi = "ISEGIRISTARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
					

					'If DegiskenAdi = "SIGORTASICILNO" then 
									
						'Uzunluk = Len(trim(Degisken))
						'For j = 1 to Uzunluk
							'DegiskenChar = mid(trim(Degisken),j,1)
							'res = pe1.write(satirpozr,sol + j*5.1 , satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, DegiskenChar)
						'Next
					'End if	

				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)

				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next				

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "AD_SOYAD"
	Grid(1,0) = "BABA_ADI"
	Grid(2,0) = "DOGUM_TARIHI"
	Grid(3,0) = "CINSIYET"
	Grid(4,0) = "EK1GOREVKODU"
	Grid(5,0) = "ISEGIRISTARIHI"
	Grid(6,0) = "EK1SGKK"
	Grid(7,0) = "SIGORTASICILNO"

	Grid(0,1) = 50
	Grid(1,1) = 28
	Grid(2,1) = 24
	Grid(3,1) = 19
	Grid(4,1) = 17
	Grid(5,1) = 20
	Grid(6,1) = 19
	Grid(7,1) = 74

	Grid(0,2) = "ADI SOYADI         (4)"
	Grid(1,2) = "BABA   (5)"
	Grid(2,2) = "DOÐUM TARÝHÝ (6)"
	Grid(3,2) = "CÝNSÝYETÝ E/K (7)"
	Grid(4,2) = "GÖREV KODU (8)"
	Grid(5,2) = "ÝÞE GÝRÝÞ TARÝHÝ(9)"
	Grid(6,2) = "SOS.GÜV KODU(10)"
	Grid(7,2) = "SÝCÝL NO (11)"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "D"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "N"

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 20
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 20
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 25
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satiryuksekligi2 = 4
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 70
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSB40T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(PERSB40T.PERSONELSICILNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi2
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi2
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = PERSB40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

					If DegiskenAdi = "DOGUM_TARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
 					If DegiskenAdi = "ISTENCIKISTARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
					
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)

				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next				

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "AD_SOYAD"
	Grid(1,0) = "BABA_ADI"
	Grid(2,0) = "DOGUM_TARIHI"
	Grid(3,0) = "ISTENCIKISTARIHI"
	Grid(4,0) = "CIKIS_TURU"
	Grid(5,0) = "EK1SGKK"
	Grid(6,0) = "SIGORTASICILNO"

	Grid(0,1) = 79
	Grid(1,1) = 34
	Grid(2,1) = 18
	Grid(3,1) = 23
	Grid(4,1) = 23
	Grid(5,1) = 17
	Grid(6,1) = 65

	Grid(0,2) = "ADI SOYADI         (4)"
	Grid(1,2) = "BABA ADI (5)"
	Grid(2,2) = "DOÐUM TARÝHÝ (6)"
	Grid(3,2) = "ÝÞTEN ÇIKIÞ TARÝHÝ(7)"
	Grid(4,2) = "ÝÞTEN ÇIKIÞ NEDENÝ(8)"
	Grid(5,2) = "SOS.GÜV KODU(9)"
	Grid(6,2) = "SÝCÝL NO (11)"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "D"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 210
	sayfaEni = 297
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 20
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10 
	SolMargin = 20
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 25
	satiryuksekligi = 5
	satiryuksekligi2 = 4
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 70
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 10 * satirYuksekligi
	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satinalma Siparisi",  SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = PERSB40T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(PERSB40T.PERSONELSICILNO(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
'					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi2
					satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi2
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = SolMargin + 2
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = PERSB40T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

					If DegiskenAdi = "DOGUM_TARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
 					If DegiskenAdi = "ISTENCIKISTARIHI" then
						Degisken = Doc.StrtoNorDate(Degisken)
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					End if	
					
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi2, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)

				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				If satirNo = 1 Then
					xCizgi(UBound(xCizgi)-1) = Sol - 2
					ReDim Preserve xCizgi(Ubound(xCizgi)+1)
				End If
			Next				

		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(7,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "AD_SOYAD"
	Grid(1,0) = "BABA_ADI"
	Grid(2,0) = "DOGUM_TARIHI"
	Grid(3,0) = "ISTENCIKISTARIHI"
	Grid(4,0) = "CIKIS_TURU"
	Grid(5,0) = "EK1SGKK"
	Grid(6,0) = "SIGORTASICILNO"

	Grid(0,1) = 79
	Grid(1,1) = 34
	Grid(2,1) = 18
	Grid(3,1) = 23
	Grid(4,1) = 23
	Grid(5,1) = 17
	Grid(6,1) = 65

	Grid(0,2) = "ADI SOYADI         (4)"
	Grid(1,2) = "BABA ADI (5)"
	Grid(2,2) = "DOÐUM TARÝHÝ (6)"
	Grid(3,2) = "ÝÞTEN ÇIKIÞ TARÝHÝ(7)"
	Grid(4,2) = "ÝÞTEN ÇIKIÞ NEDENÝ(8)"
	Grid(5,2) = "SOS.GÜV KODU(9)"
	Grid(6,2) = "SÝCÝL NO (11)"
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "D"
	Grid(3,4) = "D"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "N"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi, satiryuksekligi2

Public Secilenler()
